     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Edge function: complete-auto-topup-setup
    10→ * 
    11→ * Completes auto-top-up setup by extracting payment method from checkout session
    12→ * Called after successful checkout with auto-top-up enabled
    13→ * 
    14→ * POST /functions/v1/complete-auto-topup-setup
    15→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service_role_key>
    16→ * Body: { sessionId: string, userId: string }
    17→ * 
    18→ * Returns:
    19→ * - 200 OK with payment method details
    20→ * - 400 Bad Request if invalid parameters
    21→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    22→ */
    23→serve(async (req) => {
    24→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler(req, {
    25→    functionName: "complete-auto-topup-setup",
    26→    logPrefix: "[COMPLETE-AUTO-TOPUP-SETUP]",
    27→    parseBody: "strict",
    28→    auth: {
    29→      required: true,
    30→      requireServiceRole: true,
    31→    },
    32→    ...NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS,
    33→  });
    34→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
    35→    return bootstrap.response;
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger, body, auth } = bootstrap.value;
    39→  const authResult = ensureServiceRoleAuth(auth, logger);
    40→  if (!authResult.ok) {
    41→    await logger.flush();
    42→    return authResult.response;
    43→  }
    44→  
    45→  const { sessionId, userId } = body;
    46→
    47→  if (!sessionId || !userId) {
    48→    return jsonResponse({ error: "sessionId and userId are required" }, 400);
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  try {
    52→    // ─── 4. Initialize Stripe ───────────────────────────────────────
    53→    const stripeResult = await ensureStripeClient(logger);
    54→    if (!stripeResult.ok) {
    55→      return stripeResult.response;
    56→    }
    57→    const stripe = stripeResult.stripe;
    58→
    59→    // ─── 5. Retrieve checkout session and payment intent ────────────
    60→    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId, {
    61→      expand: ['payment_intent', 'setup_intent']
    62→    });
    63→
    64→    if (!session.payment_intent) {
    65→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No payment intent found in session" }, 400);
    66→    }
    67→
    68→    // Get the payment intent with payment method details
    69→    const paymentIntent = await stripe.paymentIntents.retrieve(
    70→      session.payment_intent as string,
    71→      { expand: ['payment_method'] }
    72→    );
    73→
    74→    if (!paymentIntent.customer) {
    75→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No customer associated with payment intent" }, 400);
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    if (!paymentIntent.payment_method) {
    79→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No payment method found" }, 400);
    80→    }
    81→
    82→    // ─── 6. Update user with complete Stripe information ─────────────
    83→    const { error: updateError } = await supabaseAdmin
    84→      .from('users')
    85→      .update({
    86→        stripe_customer_id: paymentIntent.customer as string,
    87→        stripe_payment_method_id: paymentIntent.payment_method.id,
    88→      })
    89→      .eq('id', userId);
    90→
    91→    if (updateError) {
    92→      logger.error('Error updating user with payment method', { error: updateError.message, user_id: userId });
    93→      await logger.flush();
    94→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to save payment method' }, 500);
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    logger.info('Auto-top-up setup completed', {
    98→      user_id: userId,
    99→      sessionId,
   100→      customerId: paymentIntent.customer,
   101→      paymentMethodId: paymentIntent.payment_method.id,
   102→      paymentMethodType: paymentIntent.payment_method.type,
   103→    });
   104→
   105→    await logger.flush();
   106→    return jsonResponse({
   107→      success: true,
   108→      customerId: paymentIntent.customer,
   109→      paymentMethodId: paymentIntent.payment_method.id,
   110→      paymentMethodType: paymentIntent.payment_method.type,
   111→      message: 'Auto-top-up setup completed successfully'
   112→    });
   113→
   114→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   115→    const errorMessage = toErrorMessage(error);
   116→    logger.error('Error in complete-auto-topup-setup', { error: errorMessage });
   117→    
   118→    // Handle specific Stripe errors
   119→    const stripeErrorType = (error as { type?: string } | null)?.type;
   120→    if (stripeErrorType === 'StripeInvalidRequestError') {
   121→      return jsonResponse({
   122→        error: 'Invalid Stripe request',
   123→        message: errorMessage,
   124→      }, 400);
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    await logger.flush();
   128→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Internal server error' }, 500);
   129→  }
   130→});

1→/**
     2→ * useReplaceInShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles swapping timeline position from a parent generation to the current image.
     5→ * Used when user wants to replace a parent image in the timeline with a derived image.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→
    12→interface UseReplaceInShotProps {
    13→  /** Callback to close the lightbox after successful replacement */
    14→  onClose: () => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    18→  /**
    19→   * Replace parent's timeline position with current image
    20→   * @param parentGenerationId - ID of the parent generation to remove from timeline
    21→   * @param currentMediaId - ID of the current media to place in timeline
    22→   * @param parentTimelineFrame - Timeline frame position to use
    23→   * @param shotId - Shot ID for the replacement
    24→   */
    25→  handleReplaceInShot: (
    26→    parentGenerationId: string,
    27→    currentMediaId: string,
    28→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    29→    shotId: string
    30→  ) => Promise<ReplaceInShotResult>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→type ReplaceInShotFailureStage =
    34→  | 'clear_parent'
    35→  | 'fetch_target_assoc'
    36→  | 'assign_target'
    37→  | 'restore_parent';
    38→
    39→export type ReplaceInShotResult =
    40→  | { ok: true }
    41→  | {
    42→      ok: false;
    43→      stage: ReplaceInShotFailureStage;
    44→      recovered: boolean;
    45→      message: string;
    46→    };
    47→
    48→export function useReplaceInShot({
    49→  onClose,
    50→}: UseReplaceInShotProps): UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    51→  const handleReplaceInShot = useCallback(async (
    52→    parentGenerationId: string,
    53→    currentMediaId: string,
    54→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    55→    shotIdParam: string
    56→  ): Promise<ReplaceInShotResult> => {
    57→    const restoreParentTimelineFrame = async (): Promise<Error | null> => {
    58→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    59→        .update({ timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame })
    60→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    61→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    62→      return error ?? null;
    63→    };
    64→
    65→    try {
    66→      // 1. Remove timeline_frame from parent's shot_generation record
    67→      const { error: removeError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    68→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
    69→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    70→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    71→
    72→      if (removeError) {
    73→        throw {
    74→          stage: 'clear_parent' as const,
    75→          recovered: false,
    76→          cause: removeError,
    77→        };
    78→      }
    79→
    80→      // 2. Update or create shot_generation for current image with the timeline_frame
    81→      // First check if current image already has a shot_generation for this shot
    82→      const { data: existingAssoc, error: existingAssocError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→        .select('id')
    84→        .eq('generation_id', currentMediaId)
    85→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam)
    86→        .maybeSingle();
    87→
    88→      if (existingAssocError) {
    89→        const restoreError = await restoreParentTimelineFrame();
    90→        throw {
    91→          stage: restoreError ? 'restore_parent' as const : 'fetch_target_assoc' as const,
    92→          recovered: !restoreError,
    93→          cause: existingAssocError,
    94→          restoreError,
    95→        };
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      if (existingAssoc) {
    99→        // Update existing
   100→        const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   101→          .update({
   102→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
   103→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
   104→          })
   105→          .eq('id', existingAssoc.id);
   106→
   107→        if (updateError) {
   108→          const restoreError = await restoreParentTimelineFrame();
   109→          throw {
   110→            stage: restoreError ? 'restore_parent' as const : 'assign_target' as const,
   111→            recovered: !restoreError,
   112→            cause: updateError,
   113→            restoreError,
   114→          };
   115→        }
   116→      } else {
   117→        // Create new
   118→        const { error: createError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   119→          .insert({
   120→            shot_id: shotIdParam,
   121→            generation_id: currentMediaId,
   122→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
   123→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
   124→          });
   125→
   126→        if (createError) {
   127→          const restoreError = await restoreParentTimelineFrame();
   128→          throw {
   129→            stage: restoreError ? 'restore_parent' as const : 'assign_target' as const,
   130→            recovered: !restoreError,
   131→            cause: createError,
   132→            restoreError,
   133→          };
   134→        }
   135→      }
   136→
   137→      // Close lightbox to force refresh when reopened
   138→      onClose();
   139→      return { ok: true };
   140→    } catch (error) {
   141→      const failure = (
   142→        error && typeof error === 'object' && 'stage' in error && 'recovered' in error
   143→      ) ? error as {
   144→        stage: ReplaceInShotFailureStage;
   145→        recovered: boolean;
   146→        cause: unknown;
   147→        restoreError?: unknown;
   148→      } : null;
   149→
   150→      normalizeAndPresentError(failure?.cause ?? error, {
   151→        context: 'useReplaceInShot',
   152→        showToast: false,
   153→        logData: failure
   154→          ? {
   155→              stage: failure.stage,
   156→              recovered: failure.recovered,
   157→              restoreError: failure.restoreError,
   158→            }
   159→          : undefined,
   160→      });
   161→      return {
   162→        ok: false,
   163→        stage: failure?.stage ?? 'assign_target',
   164→        recovered: failure?.recovered ?? false,
   165→        message: failure?.recovered
   166→          ? 'Replace-in-shot failed, but the parent timeline position was restored.'
   167→          : 'Replace-in-shot failed after mutating timeline state.',
   168→      };
   169→    }
   170→  }, [onClose]);
   171→
   172→  return { handleReplaceInShot };
   173→}
   174→

    18→/**

    20→ * Only fetches when hovering (lazy loading to avoid query spam)
    21→ */
    22→export function useVideoGenerations({
    23→  task,
    24→  taskParams,
    25→  isVideoTask,
    26→  isCompletedVideoTask,
    27→  isHovering,
    28→}: UseVideoGenerationsOptions) {
    29→  // State to control when to fetch video generations (on hover)
    30→  const [shouldFetchVideo, setShouldFetchVideo] = useState(false);
    31→
    32→  // State to track if user clicked the button (not just hovered)
    33→  const [waitingForVideoToOpen, setWaitingForVideoToOpen] = useState(false);
    34→
    35→  // Trigger video fetch when hovering over completed video tasks
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (isHovering && isCompletedVideoTask && !shouldFetchVideo) {
    38→      setShouldFetchVideo(true);
    39→    }
    40→  }, [isHovering, isCompletedVideoTask, shouldFetchVideo, task.id]);
    41→
    42→  // Fetch video generations
    43→  const { data: videoGenerations, isLoading: isLoadingVideoGen } = useQuery({
    44→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.videoForTask(task.id), task.outputLocation],
    45→    queryFn: async () => {
    46→
    47→      if (!isVideoTask || task.status !== 'Complete') {
    48→        return null;
    49→      }
    50→
    51→      // For individual_travel_segment tasks with child_generation_id, fetch that generation directly
    52→      const childGenerationId =
    53→        typeof taskParams.parsed?.child_generation_id === 'string'
    54→          ? taskParams.parsed.child_generation_id
    55→          : null;
    56→      if (task.taskType === 'individual_travel_segment' && childGenerationId) {
    57→        const { data: childGen, error: childError } = await supabase().from('generations')
    58→          .select('*, generation_variants(*)')
    59→          .eq('id', childGenerationId)
    60→          .single();
    61→
    62→        if (!childError && childGen) {
    63→          const variants = ((childGen as Record<string, unknown>).generation_variants as Array<{ id: string; location: string; thumbnail_url: string | null; is_primary: boolean; params: Record<string, unknown> | null }>) || [];
    64→          const taskVariant = variants.find((v) => v.params?.source_task_id === task.id);
    65→          const primaryVariant = variants.find((v) => v.is_primary);
    66→          const targetVariant = taskVariant || primaryVariant;
    67→
    68→          if (targetVariant) {
    69→            return [{
    70→              ...childGen,
    71→              location: targetVariant.location,
    72→              thumbnail_url: targetVariant.thumbnail_url || childGen.thumbnail_url,
    73→              _variant_id: targetVariant.id,
    74→              _variant_is_primary: targetVariant.is_primary,
    75→            }];
    76→          }
    77→          return [childGen];
    78→        }
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      // Try to find generation by output location first (most reliable)
    82→      if (task.outputLocation) {
    83→        const { data: byLocation, error: locError } = await supabase().from('generations')
    84→          .select('*')
    85→          .eq('location', task.outputLocation)
    86→          .eq('project_id', task.projectId);
    87→
    88→        if (!locError && byLocation && byLocation.length > 0) {
    89→          return byLocation;
    90→        }
    91→
    92→        // If not found in generations, check generation_variants by location
    93→        const variantGeneration = await findGenerationByVariantLocation(task.outputLocation, supabase());
    94→        if (variantGeneration) {
    95→          return [{
    96→            ...variantGeneration.generation,
    97→            _variant_id: variantGeneration.variantId,
    98→            _variant_is_primary: variantGeneration.variantIsPrimary,
    99→          }];
   100→        }
   101→      }
   102→
   103→      // Fallback: Search by task ID in the tasks JSONB array
   104→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
   105→        .select('*')
   106→        .filter('tasks', 'cs', JSON.stringify([task.id]))
   107→        .eq('project_id', task.projectId)
   108→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   109→
   110→      if (error) {
   111→        console.error('[useVideoGenerations] Error fetching video generations:', error);
   112→        throw error;
   113→      }
   114→
   115→      if (data && data.length > 0) {
   116→        return data;
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // FINAL FALLBACK: If no generation record exists but task has outputLocation,
   120→      // create a minimal pseudo-generation from the task data
   121→      // This handles cases where complete-task failed to create the generation record
   122→      if (task.outputLocation) {
   123→        return [{
   124→          id: task.id, // Use task ID as pseudo-generation ID
   125→          location: task.outputLocation,
   126→          thumbnail_url: null,
   127→          type: 'video',
   128→          created_at: task.createdAt,
   129→          project_id: task.projectId,
   130→          params: task.params,
   131→          _is_fallback: true, // Mark as fallback so we know it's not a real generation
   132→        }];
   133→      }
   134→
   135→      return [];
   136→    },
   137→    enabled: shouldFetchVideo && isVideoTask && task.status === 'Complete',
   138→  });
   139→
   140→  // Transform video generations to GenerationRow format
   141→  const videoOutputs = useMemo(() => {
   142→    if (!videoGenerations) return null;
   143→    
   144→    const taskParentGenerationId = extractTaskParentGenerationId(taskParams.parsed);
   145→    
   146→    return videoGenerations.map((gen) => {
   147→      const genRecord = gen as Record<string, unknown>;
   148→      // Individual segments have their parent_generation_id on the generation itself (from DB)
   149→      // Other video tasks may have it in task params or on the generation
   150→      const effectiveParentGenId = (genRecord.parent_generation_id as string | undefined) || taskParentGenerationId;
   151→      const location = (genRecord.location as string | null | undefined) ?? null;
   152→      const thumbnailUrl = (genRecord.thumbnail_url as string | null | undefined) ?? null;
   153→      const type = (genRecord.type as string | null | undefined) ?? 'video';
   154→      const createdAt =
   155→        (genRecord.created_at as string | null | undefined) ||
   156→        task.createdAt ||
   157→        new Date().toISOString();
   158→      const metadata = (genRecord.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) || {};
   159→      const generationId =
   160→        (genRecord.id as string | undefined) ||
   161→        task.id;
   162→
   163→      return {
   164→        id: generationId,
   165→        location,
   166→        imageUrl: location,
   167→        thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl || location,
   168→        videoUrl: (genRecord.video_url as string | undefined) || location,
   169→        type,
   170→        createdAt,
   171→        taskId: genRecord.task_id as string | undefined,
   172→        metadata,
   173→        name: (genRecord.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   174→        parent_generation_id: effectiveParentGenId || undefined,
   175→        _variant_id: genRecord._variant_id as string | undefined,
   176→        _variant_is_primary: genRecord._variant_is_primary as boolean | undefined,
   177→      } as GenerationRow;
   178→    });
   179→  }, [videoGenerations, taskParams.parsed]);
   180→
   181→  // Trigger fetch (for click before hover)
   182→  const ensureFetch = useCallback(() => {
   183→    setShouldFetchVideo(true);
   184→  }, []);
   185→
   186→  const triggerOpen = useCallback(() => {
   187→    setShouldFetchVideo(true);
   188→    setWaitingForVideoToOpen(true);
   189→  }, []);
   190→
   191→  const clearWaiting = () => {
   192→    setWaitingForVideoToOpen(false);
   193→  };
   194→
   195→  return {
   196→    videoOutputs,
   197→    isLoadingVideoGen,
   198→    shouldFetchVideo,
   199→    waitingForVideoToOpen,
   200→    ensureFetch,
   201→    triggerOpen,
   202→    clearWaiting,
   203→  };
   204→}
   205→

    32→async function createSingleMaskedEditTask(

    64→      loras && loras.length > 0 ? { loras } : undefined,
    65→      create_as_generation ? { create_as_generation: true } : undefined,
    66→      source_variant_id ? { source_variant_id } : undefined,
    67→      buildHiresFixParams(hires_fix),
    68→      qwen_edit_model ? { qwen_edit_model } : undefined,
    69→    ],
    70→  });
    71→
    72→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
    73→    params,
    74→    context: config.context,
    75→    buildTaskRequest: (pipelineParams) => composeTaskRequest({
    76→      source: pipelineParams,
    77→      taskType: config.taskType,
    78→      params: taskParams,
    79→    }),
    80→  });
    81→}
    82→
    83→export async function createMaskedEditTask(
    84→  config: MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig,
    85→  params: MaskedEditTaskParams,
    86→): Promise<string> {
    87→  const { num_generations, ...singleTaskParams } = params;
    88→
    89→  if (num_generations === 1) {
    90→    const result = await createSingleMaskedEditTask(config, singleTaskParams);
    91→    return result.task_id;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    95→    Array.from({ length: num_generations }, () => createSingleMaskedEditTask(config, singleTaskParams)),
    96→  );
    97→
    98→  const successful = processBatchResults(results, config.batchOperationName);
    99→  return successful[0].task_id;

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→let lifecycleHooksRegistered = false;
    45→
    46→function createAbortError(): Error {
    47→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    48→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    49→  }
    50→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    51→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    52→  return error;
    53→}
    54→
    55→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    56→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    57→    throw createAbortError();
    58→  }
    59→}
    60→
    61→function registerLifecycleHooks(): void {
    62→  if (lifecycleHooksRegistered || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    63→    return;
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    67→    flushAll();
    68→  });
    69→  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    70→    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    }
    73→  });
    74→  lifecycleHooksRegistered = true;
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Initialize the queue with the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    79→ * Must be called during app bootstrap before any settings write is enqueued.
    80→ */
    81→export function initializeSettingsWriteQueue(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    82→  writeFunction = fn;
    83→  registerLifecycleHooks();
    84→}
    85→
    86→/** @internal Only for test isolation — do not call in production code. */
    87→export function resetSettingsWriteQueueForTests(): void {
    88→  for (const pending of pendingByTarget.values()) {
    89→    if (pending.timerId) {
    90→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
    91→    }
    92→  }
    93→  pendingByTarget.clear();
    94→  flushQueue.length = 0;
    95→  inFlightCount = 0;
    96→  writeFunction = null;
    97→  lifecycleHooksRegistered = false;
    98→}
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
   102→ */
   103→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
   104→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
   109→ */
   110→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
   111→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
   112→}
   113→
   114→/**
   115→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
   116→ */
   117→async function processQueue() {
   118→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   119→    return;
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   123→  if (!next) return;
   124→
   125→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   126→  
   127→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   128→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   129→  
   130→  inFlightCount++;
   131→  
   132→  try {
   133→    if (!writeFunction) {
   134→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   135→    }
   136→
   137→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   138→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   139→    
   140→    // Resolve all waiters
   141→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   142→      resolve(result);
   143→    }
   144→  } catch (error) {
   145→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   146→
   147→    // Reject all waiters
   148→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   149→      reject(error);
   150→    }
   151→  } finally {
   152→    inFlightCount--;
   153→    
   154→    // Process next item
   155→    processQueue();
   156→  }
   157→}
   158→
   159→/**
   160→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   161→ */
   162→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   163→  // Clear existing timer
   164→  if (pending.timerId) {
   165→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   166→    pending.timerId = null;
   167→  }
   168→  
   169→  // Add to flush queue and process
   170→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   171→  processQueue();
   172→}
   173→
   174→/**
   175→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   176→ * 
   177→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   178→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   179→ * 
   180→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   181→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   182→ */
   183→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   184→  write: QueuedWrite,
   185→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   186→): Promise<unknown> {
   187→  if (!writeFunction) {
   188→    throw new Error(
   189→      '[SettingsWriteQueue] enqueueSettingsWrite called before initializeSettingsWriteQueue. ' +
   190→      'Ensure app bootstrap initializes the queue before settings writes run.'
   191→    );
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  const key = targetKey(write);
   195→
   196→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   197→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   198→      reject(createAbortError());
   199→      return;
   200→    }
   201→
   202→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   203→
   204→    if (existing) {
   205→      // Merge with existing pending write
   206→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   207→      if (write.signal) {
   208→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   209→      }
   210→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   211→
   212→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   213→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   214→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   215→      }
   216→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   217→      
   218→    } else {
   219→      // Create new pending write
   220→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   221→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   222→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   223→        timerId: null,
   224→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   225→      };
   226→
   227→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   228→
   229→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   230→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   231→      } else {
   232→        // Set debounce timer
   233→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   234→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   235→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   236→      }
   237→    }
   238→  });
   239→}
   240→
   241→
   242→/**
   243→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   244→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   245→ */
   246→function flushAll(): void {
   247→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   248→    if (pending.timerId) {
   249→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   250→      pending.timerId = null;
   251→    }
   252→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   253→  }
   254→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   255→  processQueue();
   256→}
   257→

     4→ * The cache is populated once on app load by useAllTaskTypesConfig (in hooks/tasks/useTaskType.ts).
     5→ * Consumers in lib/ (e.g. taskConfig.ts) read from here without importing from hooks/.

     9→  id: string;

    17→}
    18→
    19→// Global cache for synchronous access (populated by useAllTaskTypesConfig hook)
    20→let _taskTypeConfigCache: Record<string, TaskTypeInfo> = {};
    21→let _cacheInitialized = false;
    22→
    23→/** Get the global task type config cache */

    25→  return _taskTypeConfigCache;

    27→
    28→/** Check if the cache has been initialized */
    29→export function isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized(): boolean {
    30→  return _cacheInitialized;
    31→}
    32→
    33→/** Update the global cache (called from the hook after fetching) */
    34→export function setTaskTypeConfigCache(cache: Record<string, TaskTypeInfo>): void {
    35→  _taskTypeConfigCache = cache;

1→import {
     2→  callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc,
     3→  resolveSettingsScopeTable,
     4→  selectSettingsForScope,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/toolSettingsWriteRepository';
     6→import {
     7→  enqueueSettingsWrite,
     8→  initializeSettingsWriteQueue,
     9→  type QueuedWrite,
    10→} from '@/shared/lib/settingsWriteQueue';
    11→import { deepMerge } from '@/shared/lib/utils/deepEqual';
    12→import { isCancellationError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
    13→import { ToolSettingsError } from '@/shared/lib/toolSettingsService';
    14→
    15→export type SettingsScope = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    16→type SettingsWriteMode = 'debounced' | 'immediate';
    17→
    18→interface UpdateToolSettingsParams {
    19→  scope: SettingsScope;
    20→  id: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: unknown;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface AbortSignalCapable<T> {
    26→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;
    27→}
    28→
    29→function isAbortSignal(value: unknown): value is AbortSignal {
    30→  return !!value
    31→    && typeof value === 'object'
    32→    && 'aborted' in value
    33→    && typeof (value as AbortSignal).addEventListener === 'function';
    34→}
    35→
    36→function isSettingsWriteMode(value: unknown): value is SettingsWriteMode {
    37→  return value === 'debounced' || value === 'immediate';
    38→}
    39→
    40→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
    41→  if (!signal) return query;
    42→
    43→  const candidate = query as T & AbortSignalCapable<T>;
    44→  if (typeof candidate.abortSignal === 'function') {
    45→    return candidate.abortSignal(signal);
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  return query;
    49→}
    50→
    51→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    52→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    53→    throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
    54→      recoverable: true,
    55→      cause: signal.reason,
    56→    });
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→async function fetchSettingsForScope(
    61→  scope: SettingsScope,
    62→  id: string,
    63→  signal?: AbortSignal,
    64→) {
    65→  throwIfAborted(signal);
    66→
    67→  return maybeAttachAbortSignal(selectSettingsForScope(scope, id), signal);
    68→}
    69→
    70→async function rawUpdateToolSettings(write: QueuedWrite): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
    71→  const { scope, entityId: id, toolId, patch, signal } = write;
    72→
    73→  try {
    74→    if (scope !== 'user' && scope !== 'project' && scope !== 'shot') {
    75→      throw new ToolSettingsError(
    76→        'invalid_scope_identifier',
    77→        `Invalid scope: ${scope}`,
    78→      );
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    82→    const { data: currentEntity, error: fetchError } = await fetchSettingsForScope(scope, id, signal);
    83→
    84→    if (fetchError) {
    85→      const errorMessage = fetchError.message || '';
    86→      if (
    87→        errorMessage.includes('ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES')
    88→        || errorMessage.includes('Failed to fetch')
    89→        || fetchError.code === 'ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES'
    90→      ) {
    91→        throw new ToolSettingsError(
    92→          'network',
    93→          `Network exhaustion: ${errorMessage}`,
    94→          { recoverable: true, cause: fetchError },
    95→        );
    96→      }
    97→      throw new ToolSettingsError(
    98→        'scope_fetch_failed',
    99→        `Failed to fetch current ${scope} settings: ${errorMessage}`,
   100→        { recoverable: true, cause: fetchError },
   101→      );
   102→    }
   103→
   104→    const currentSettings = (currentEntity?.settings as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   105→    const currentToolSettings = (currentSettings[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   106→    const updatedToolSettings = deepMerge({}, currentToolSettings, patch);
   107→
   108→    throwIfAborted(signal);
   109→    const { error: rpcError } = await maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   110→      callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
   111→        tableName,
   112→        id,
   113→        toolId,
   114→        updatedToolSettings,
   115→      ),
   116→      signal,
   117→    );
   118→
   119→    if (rpcError) {
   120→      throw new ToolSettingsError(
   121→        'scope_fetch_failed',
   122→        `Failed to update ${scope} settings: ${rpcError.message}`,
   123→        { recoverable: true, cause: rpcError },
   124→      );
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    return updatedToolSettings;
   128→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   129→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   130→      throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   131→        recoverable: true,
   132→        cause: error,
   133→      });
   134→    }
   135→
   136→    throw error;
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→export function initializeToolSettingsWriteRuntime(): void {
   141→  initializeSettingsWriteQueue(rawUpdateToolSettings);
   142→}
   143→
   144→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   145→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   146→  mode?: SettingsWriteMode,
   147→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   148→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   149→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   150→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   151→  mode?: SettingsWriteMode,
   152→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   153→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   154→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   155→  signalOrMode?: AbortSignal | SettingsWriteMode,
   156→  maybeMode: SettingsWriteMode = 'debounced',
   157→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
   158→  const { scope, id, toolId, patch } = params;
   159→  const signal = isAbortSignal(signalOrMode) ? signalOrMode : undefined;
   160→  const mode = isSettingsWriteMode(signalOrMode) ? signalOrMode : maybeMode;
   161→
   162→  return enqueueSettingsWrite({
   163→    scope,
   164→    entityId: id,
   165→    toolId,
   166→    patch: patch as Record<string, unknown>,
   167→    ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
   168→  }, mode) as Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   169→}
   170→

    87→  primaryStructureVideo?: PrimaryStructureVideo;
    88→  onAddStructureVideo?: (video: StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata) => void;
    89→  onUpdateStructureVideo?: (index: number, updates: Partial<StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata>) => void;
    90→  onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange?: StructureVideoSelectionArgs['onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange'];
    91→  setShowVideoBrowser: (value: boolean) => void;

    93→
    94→export interface TimelineOrchestratorActionsResult {
    95→  handleImageDropInterceptor: (files: File[], targetFrame?: number) => Promise<void>;
    96→  handleGenerationDropInterceptor: (
    97→    generationId: string,
    98→    imageUrl: string,
    99→    thumbUrl: string | undefined,
   100→    targetFrame?: number,
   101→  ) => Promise<void>;
   102→  handleDuplicateInterceptor: (imageId: string, timelineFrame: number) => void;
   103→  handleTapToMoveAction: (imageId: string, targetFrame: number) => Promise<void>;
   104→  handleTapToMoveMultiAction: (imageIds: string[], targetFrame: number) => Promise<void>;
   105→  handleTimelineTapToMove: (clientX: number) => void;
   106→  handleVideoBrowserSelect: (resource: Resource) => void;
   107→}
   108→
   109→export async function runImageDropInterceptor({
   110→  files,
   111→  targetFrame,
   112→  onFileDrop,
   113→  setPendingDropFrame,
   114→}: ImageDropInterceptorArgs): Promise<void> {
   115→  if (targetFrame !== undefined) {
   116→    setPendingDropFrame(targetFrame);
   117→  }
   118→  if (onFileDrop) {
   119→    await onFileDrop(files, targetFrame);
   120→  }
   121→}
   122→
   123→export async function runGenerationDropInterceptor({
   124→  generationId,
   125→  imageUrl,
   126→  thumbUrl,
   127→  targetFrame,
   128→  onGenerationDrop,
   129→  setPendingDropFrame,
   130→  setIsInternalDropProcessing,
   131→}: GenerationDropInterceptorArgs): Promise<void> {
   132→  if (targetFrame !== undefined) {
   133→    setPendingDropFrame(targetFrame);
   134→    setIsInternalDropProcessing(true);
   135→  }
   136→  try {
   137→    if (onGenerationDrop) {
   138→      await onGenerationDrop(generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl, targetFrame);
   139→    }
   140→  } finally {
   141→    setIsInternalDropProcessing(false);
   142→    setPendingDropFrame(null);
   143→  }
   144→}
   145→
   146→export function runDuplicateInterceptor({
   147→  imageId,
   148→  timelineFrame,
   149→  images,
   150→  framePositions,
   151→  onImageDuplicate,
   152→  setPendingDuplicateFrame,
   153→}: DuplicateInterceptorArgs): void {
   154→  const sortedImages = [...images]
   155→    .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame !== undefined && img.timeline_frame !== null)
   156→    .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
   157→
   158→  const currentIndex = sortedImages.findIndex((img) => img.timeline_frame === timelineFrame);
   159→  const nextImage = currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < sortedImages.length - 1
   160→    ? sortedImages[currentIndex + 1]
   161→    : null;
   162→
   163→  const existingFrames = images
   164→    .map((img) => img.timeline_frame)
   165→    .filter((frame): frame is number => frame !== null && frame !== undefined);
   166→  const nextFrame = nextImage?.timeline_frame;
   167→  const finalFrame = calculateDuplicateFrame({
   168→    currentFrame: timelineFrame,
   169→    nextFrame: nextFrame ?? null,
   170→    existingFrames,
   171→    singleItemTrailingFrame: framePositions.get(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY) ?? null,
   172→    isSingleItem: images.length === 1,
   173→  });
   174→
   175→  setPendingDuplicateFrame(finalFrame);
   176→  onImageDuplicate(imageId, finalFrame);
   177→}
   178→
   179→export function handleTimelineStructureVideoSelect({
   180→  resource,
   181→  structureVideos,
   182→  primaryStructureVideo,
   183→  onAddStructureVideo,
   184→  onUpdateStructureVideo,
   185→  onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   186→  fullMax,
   187→  setShowVideoBrowser,
   188→}: StructureVideoSelectionArgs): void {
   189→  const metadata = resource.metadata as StructureVideoMetadata;
   190→  if (onAddStructureVideo && metadata.videoMetadata) {
   191→    const placement = calculateNewVideoPlacement(
   192→      metadata.videoMetadata.total_frames,
   193→      structureVideos,
   194→      fullMax,
   195→    );
   196→
   197→    if (placement.lastVideoUpdate && onUpdateStructureVideo) {
   198→      onUpdateStructureVideo(placement.lastVideoUpdate.index, {
   199→        end_frame: placement.lastVideoUpdate.newEndFrame,
   200→      });
   201→    }
   202→
   203→    onAddStructureVideo({
   204→      path: metadata.videoUrl,
   205→      start_frame: placement.start_frame,
   206→      end_frame: placement.end_frame,
   207→      treatment: 'adjust',
   208→      metadata: metadata.videoMetadata,
   209→      resource_id: resource.id,
   210→    });
   211→  } else if (onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange) {
   212→    onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(
   213→      metadata.videoUrl,
   214→      metadata.videoMetadata,
   215→      primaryStructureVideo?.treatment ?? 'adjust',
   216→      primaryStructureVideo?.motionStrength ?? 1.0,
   217→      primaryStructureVideo?.structureType ?? 'flow',
   218→    );
   219→  }
   220→
   221→  setShowVideoBrowser(false);
   222→}
   223→

   248→}: UseTimelineOrchestratorActionsInput): TimelineOrchestratorActionsResult {
   249→  const handleImageDropInterceptor = useCallback(async (files: File[], targetFrame?: number) => {
   250→    await runImageDropInterceptor({

   257→
   258→  const handleGenerationDropInterceptor = useCallback(async (

   251→
   252→      setUploadProgress({

    54→    queryFn: async () => {

    56→      if (authError || !user) {

    62→        .select('id, name')

   105→
   106→      // Apply task type filter
   107→      if (filters.taskTypes && filters.taskTypes.length > 0) {
   108→        query = query.in('task_type', filters.taskTypes);
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Apply project filter
   112→      if (filters.projectIds && filters.projectIds.length > 0) {
   113→        query = query.in('project_id', filters.projectIds);
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const { data: tasksData, error: tasksError, count } = await query
   117→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   118→        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   119→
   120→      if (tasksError) {
   121→        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch tasks: ${tasksError.message}`);
   122→      }
   123→
   124→      const taskIds = tasksData?.map(task => task.id) || [];
   125→      const costsData = await fetchTaskLogCosts(taskIds);
   126→
   127→      // Combine tasks with cost information
   128→      let tasks: TaskWithCost[] = (tasksData || []).map(task => {
   129→        const costEntry = costsData.find(cost => cost.task_id === task.id);
   130→        let duration: number | undefined;
   131→        
   132→        // Calculate duration if both timestamps exist
   133→        if (task.generation_started_at && task.generation_processed_at) {
   134→          const start = new Date(task.generation_started_at);
   135→          const end = new Date(task.generation_processed_at);
   136→          duration = Math.ceil((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 1000); // in seconds
   137→        }
   138→
   139→        return {
   140→          id: task.id,
   141→          taskType: task.task_type,
   142→          status: task.status,
   143→          createdAt: task.created_at,
   144→          generationStartedAt: task.generation_started_at,
   145→          generationProcessedAt: task.generation_processed_at,
   146→          projectId: task.project_id,
   147→          projectName: projectLookup[task.project_id] || 'Unknown Project',
   148→          cost: costEntry ? Math.abs(costEntry.amount) : undefined,
   149→          duration,
   150→        };
   151→      });
   152→
   153→      // Apply cost filter (client-side since it depends on joined data)
   154→      if (filters.costFilter === 'free') {
   155→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => !task.cost || task.cost === 0);
   156→      } else if (filters.costFilter === 'paid') {
   157→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => task.cost && task.cost > 0);
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Get available filter options
   161→      // Use visible task types from centralized config (same as TasksPane dropdown)
   162→      // Show ALL visible types, not just ones user has used (matches TasksPane behavior)
   163→      const visibleTaskTypes = getVisibleTaskTypes();
   164→      
   165→      // Query for unique statuses from user's visible tasks
   166→      let allTasksQuery = supabase().from('tasks')
   167→        .select('task_type, status, project_id')
   168→        .in('project_id', projectIds);
   169→      
   170→      if (hiddenTaskTypes.length > 0) {
   171→        allTasksQuery = allTasksQuery.not('task_type', 'in', `(${hiddenTaskTypes.join(',')})`);
   172→      }
   173→      
   174→      const { data: allTasks } = await allTasksQuery;
   175→
   176→      const availableFilters = {
   177→        // Show all visible task types (same as TasksPane dropdown)
   178→        taskTypes: visibleTaskTypes.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)),
   179→        projects: projects,
   180→        statuses: [...new Set((allTasks || []).map(t => t.status))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
   181→      };
   182→
   183→      const total = count || 0;
   184→      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
   185→      const hasMore = page < totalPages;
   186→
   187→      return {
   188→        tasks,
   189→        pagination: {
   190→          limit,
   191→          offset,
   192→          total,
   193→          hasMore,
   194→          totalPages,
   195→          currentPage: page,
   196→        },
   197→        availableFilters
   198→      };
   199→    },
   200→  });
   201→} 
   202→

     3→import type { PersistedGenerationParams } from '@/domains/generation/types/generationParams';

    10→
    11→interface ProjectScopedGenerationInput {
    12→  id: string;
    13→  projectId: string;
    14→}
    15→
    16→export interface ExternalUploadGenerationParams extends PersistedGenerationParams {
    17→  prompt: string;
    18→  extra: {

    33→
    34→type ScopedMutationRowsResult<Row extends { id: string }> = Promise<{
    35→  data: Row[] | null;
    36→  error: unknown;
    37→}>;
    38→
    39→function requireProjectScope(projectId: string): string {
    40→  if (projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    41→    return projectId;
    42→  }
    43→
    44→  throw new Error('Mutation requires project scope');
    45→}
    46→
    47→function throwScopedMutationFailure(error: unknown, emptyMessage: string): never {
    48→  if (error instanceof Error) {
    49→    throw error;
    50→  }
    51→  if (
    52→    error &&
    53→    typeof error === 'object' &&
    54→    'message' in error &&
    55→    typeof (error as { message?: unknown }).message === 'string'
    56→  ) {
    57→    throw new Error((error as { message: string }).message);
    58→  }
    59→  throw new Error(emptyMessage);
    60→}
    61→
    62→async function assertGenerationProjectScope(
    63→  generationId: string,
    64→  projectId: string,
    65→): Promise<string> {
    66→  const scope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(generationId, projectId);
    67→  if (scope.status === 'ok') {
    68→    return projectId;
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  throw new Error(`Generation scope validation failed (${scope.status})`);
    72→}
    73→
    74→async function resolveScopedVariantGenerationId(
    75→  variantId: string,
    76→  projectId: string,
    77→): Promise<string> {
    78→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
    79→  if (scope.status === 'ok' && scope.generationId) {
    80→    return scope.generationId;
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  throw new Error(`Variant scope validation failed (${scope.status})`);
    84→}
    85→
    86→async function requireScopedRows<Row extends { id: string }>(
    87→  resultPromise: ScopedMutationRowsResult<Row>,
    88→  emptyMessage: string,
    89→): Promise<Row[]> {
    90→  const result = await resultPromise;
    91→  if (result.error) {
    92→    throwScopedMutationFailure(result.error, emptyMessage);
    93→  }
    94→  if (!result.data || result.data.length === 0) {
    95→    throw new Error(emptyMessage);
    96→  }
    97→  return result.data;
    98→}

   100→export async function updateGenerationLocationInProject(
   101→  params: ProjectScopedGenerationInput & { location: string; thumbnailUrl?: string },
   102→): Promise<void> {
   103→  const projectId = requireProjectScope(params.projectId);
   104→  await assertGenerationProjectScope(params.id, projectId);
   105→  await requireScopedRows(
   106→    getSupabaseClient()
   107→      .from('generations')
   108→      .update({
   109→        location: params.location,
   110→        ...(params.thumbnailUrl ? { thumbnail_url: params.thumbnailUrl } : {}),
   111→      })
   112→      .eq('id', params.id)
   113→      .eq('project_id', projectId)
   114→      .select('id'),
   115→    'No rows updated while enforcing generation project scope',
   116→  );
   117→}
   118→
   119→export async function createExternalUploadGeneration(
   120→  params: CreateExternalUploadGenerationInput,
   121→): Promise<GenerationRowDto & { params?: Json | null }> {
   122→  const projectId = requireProjectScope(params.projectId);
   123→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient()
   124→    .from('generations')
   125→    .insert({
   126→      location: params.imageUrl,
   127→      thumbnail_url: params.thumbnailUrl,
   128→      type: params.fileType,
   129→      project_id: projectId,
   130→      params: params.generationParams as unknown as Json,
   131→    })
   132→    .select()
   133→    .single();
   134→
   135→  if (error || !data) {
   136→    throwScopedMutationFailure(error, 'Failed to create generation');
   137→  }
   138→
   139→  const { error: variantError } = await getSupabaseClient()
   140→    .from('generation_variants')
   141→    .insert({
   142→      generation_id: data.id,
   143→      location: params.imageUrl,
   144→      thumbnail_url: params.thumbnailUrl,
   145→      is_primary: true,
   146→      variant_type: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   147→      name: 'Original',
   148→      params: params.generationParams as unknown as Json,
   149→    });
   150→
   151→  if (variantError) {
   152→    throwScopedMutationFailure(variantError, 'Failed to create primary variant');
   153→  }
   154→
   155→  return data as GenerationRowDto & { params?: Json | null };
   156→}
   157→
   158→export async function updateGenerationStarInProject(
   159→  params: ProjectScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean },
   160→): Promise<void> {
   161→  const projectId = requireProjectScope(params.projectId);
   162→  await assertGenerationProjectScope(params.id, projectId);
   163→  await requireScopedRows(

   165→      .from('generations')
   166→      .update({ starred: params.starred })
   167→      .eq('id', params.id)
   168→      .eq('project_id', projectId)
   169→      .select('id, starred'),
   170→    'No rows updated while toggling generation star',
   171→  );
   172→}

   181→      .from('generations')

   183→      .eq('id', params.id)
   184→      .eq('project_id', projectId)

   187→  );

1→import { processBatchResults, type TaskCreationResult } from '../taskCreation';
     2→
     3→interface BatchTaskPipelineConfig<TBatchParams, TSingleTaskParams> {
     4→  batchParams: TBatchParams;
     5→  validateBatchParams: (params: TBatchParams) => void;
     6→  buildSingleTaskParams: (
     7→    params: TBatchParams,
     8→  ) => Promise<TSingleTaskParams[]> | TSingleTaskParams[];
     9→  createSingleTask: (params: TSingleTaskParams) => Promise<TaskCreationResult>;
    10→  operationName: string;
    11→  onSettledResults?: (results: PromiseSettledResult<TaskCreationResult>[]) => void;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export async function runBatchTaskPipeline<TBatchParams, TSingleTaskParams>(
    15→  config: BatchTaskPipelineConfig<TBatchParams, TSingleTaskParams>,
    16→): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
    17→  config.validateBatchParams(config.batchParams);
    18→
    19→  const taskParamsList = await config.buildSingleTaskParams(config.batchParams);
    20→  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    21→    taskParamsList.map((taskParams) => config.createSingleTask(taskParams)),
    22→  );
    23→
    24→  config.onSettledResults?.(results);
    25→  return processBatchResults(results, config.operationName);
    26→}

    55→      prompt,
    56→      num_generations: 1,
    57→      generation_id,
    58→      based_on: generation_id,
    59→      parent_generation_id: generation_id,

    65→      create_as_generation ? { create_as_generation: true } : undefined,
    66→      source_variant_id ? { source_variant_id } : undefined,
    67→      buildHiresFixParams(hires_fix),
    68→      qwen_edit_model ? { qwen_edit_model } : undefined,
    69→    ],
    70→  });
    71→
    72→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({

    19→type ScheduleTimeout = (callback: () => void, delayMs: number) => ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

    21→function useManagedTimeouts() {
    22→  const timeoutIdsRef = useRef<Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>>(new Set());
    23→
    24→  const scheduleTimeout = useCallback<ScheduleTimeout>((callback, delayMs) => {
    25→    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    26→      timeoutIdsRef.current.delete(timeoutId);
    27→      callback();
    28→    }, delayMs);
    29→    timeoutIdsRef.current.add(timeoutId);
    30→    return timeoutId;
    31→  }, []);
    32→
    33→  const clearScheduledTimeouts = useCallback(() => {
    34→    for (const timeoutId of timeoutIdsRef.current) {
    35→      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    36→    }
    37→    timeoutIdsRef.current.clear();
    38→  }, []);
    39→
    40→  useEffect(() => () => {
    41→    clearScheduledTimeouts();
    42→  }, [clearScheduledTimeouts]);
    43→
    44→  return { scheduleTimeout, clearScheduledTimeouts };
    45→}

    47→function pauseThenAdvance(

    56→    setStepIndex(nextIndex);

   139→function useJoyrideCallback(input: {
   140→  completeTour: () => void;

   159→
   160→  return useCallback((data: CallBackProps) => {
   161→    const { status, index, type, action } = data;
   162→
   163→    if (type === EVENTS.STEP_AFTER || type === EVENTS.TARGET_NOT_FOUND) {
   164→      const nextIndex = index + (action === ACTIONS.PREV ? -1 : 1);
   165→      const behavior = getJoyrideAdvanceBehavior(index, action);
   166→
   167→      if (behavior.type === 'advance') {
   168→        setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   169→      } else if (behavior.type === 'pause') {
   170→        if (behavior.dispatchEvent) {

   172→        }

   176→        if (behavior.lockTasksPane) {

   178→        }
   179→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, behavior.delayMs, scheduleTimeout);

   202→        target?.click();

   204→      }

   207→    if (status === STATUS.FINISHED) {

   225→export function ProductTour() {
   226→  const { isRunning, completeTour, skipTour } = useProductTour();
   227→  const { setIsGenerationsPaneLocked, setIsTasksPaneLocked, resetAllPaneLocks } = usePanes();
   228→  const navigate = useNavigate();
   229→  const { scheduleTimeout, clearScheduledTimeouts } = useManagedTimeouts();
   230→  const { stepIndex, setStepIndex, isPaused, setIsPaused } = useTourProgressState(
   231→    isRunning,
   232→    resetAllPaneLocks
   233→  );
   234→
   235→  useEffect(() => {
   236→    if (!isRunning) {
   237→      clearScheduledTimeouts();
   238→    }
   239→  }, [clearScheduledTimeouts, isRunning]);
   240→
   241→  useSpotlightClickAdvance({
   242→    isRunning,
   243→    isPaused,
   244→    stepIndex,
   245→    setStepIndex,
   246→    setIsPaused,
   247→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   248→    scheduleTimeout,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  const handleCallback = useJoyrideCallback({
   252→    completeTour,
   253→    skipTour,
   254→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   255→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   256→    setStepIndex,
   257→    setIsPaused,
   258→    navigate,
   259→    scheduleTimeout,
   260→  });
   261→
   262→  if (!isRunning) {

   266→  return (

    43→
    44→export function useTaskLog(
    45→  limit: number = 20, 
    46→  page: number = 1, 
    47→  filters: TaskLogFilters = {}
    48→) {
    49→  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
    50→  
    51→  return useQuery<TaskLogResponse, Error>({
    52→    [REDACTED](limit, page, filters),
    53→    placeholderData: (previousData) => previousData, // Prevents table from disappearing during filter changes
    54→    queryFn: async () => {
    55→      const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase().auth.getUser();
    56→      if (authError || !user) {
    57→        throw new Error('Authentication required');
    58→      }
    59→
    60→      // First get user's projects to filter tasks
    61→      const { data: projects } = await supabase().from('projects')
    62→        .select('id, name')
    63→        .eq('user_id', user.id);
    64→
    65→      if (!projects || projects.length === 0) {
    66→        return {
    67→          tasks: [],
    68→          pagination: { 
    69→            limit, 
    70→            offset, 
    71→            total: 0, 
    72→            hasMore: false, 
    73→            totalPages: 0,
    74→            currentPage: page 
    75→          },
    76→          availableFilters: {
    77→            taskTypes: [],
    78→            projects: [],
    79→            statuses: []
    80→          }
    81→        };
    82→      }
    83→
    84→      const projectIds = projects.map(p => p.id);
    85→      const projectLookup = Object.fromEntries(projects.map(p => [p.id, p.name]));
    86→
    87→      // Get hidden task types from centralized config (same as TasksPane uses)
    88→      const hiddenTaskTypes = getHiddenTaskTypes();
    89→
    90→      // Build query with filters
    91→      // Only show visible task types (uses same centralized config as TasksPane)
    92→      let query = supabase().from('tasks')
    93→        .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
    94→        .in('project_id', projectIds);
    95→
    96→      // Exclude hidden task types if there are any defined
    97→      if (hiddenTaskTypes.length > 0) {
    98→        query = query.not('task_type', 'in', `(${hiddenTaskTypes.join(',')})`);
    99→      }
   100→
   101→      // Apply status filter
   102→      if (filters.status && filters.status.length > 0) {
   103→        query = query.in('status', filters.status as Array<'Queued' | 'In Progress' | 'Complete' | 'Failed' | 'Cancelled'>);
   104→      }
   105→
   106→      // Apply task type filter
   107→      if (filters.taskTypes && filters.taskTypes.length > 0) {
   108→        query = query.in('task_type', filters.taskTypes);
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Apply project filter
   112→      if (filters.projectIds && filters.projectIds.length > 0) {
   113→        query = query.in('project_id', filters.projectIds);
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const { data: tasksData, error: tasksError, count } = await query
   117→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   118→        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   119→
   120→      if (tasksError) {
   121→        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch tasks: ${tasksError.message}`);
   122→      }
   123→
   124→      const taskIds = tasksData?.map(task => task.id) || [];
   125→      const costsData = await fetchTaskLogCosts(taskIds);
   126→
   127→      // Combine tasks with cost information
   128→      let tasks: TaskWithCost[] = (tasksData || []).map(task => {
   129→        const costEntry = costsData.find(cost => cost.task_id === task.id);
   130→        let duration: number | undefined;
   131→        
   132→        // Calculate duration if both timestamps exist
   133→        if (task.generation_started_at && task.generation_processed_at) {
   134→          const start = new Date(task.generation_started_at);
   135→          const end = new Date(task.generation_processed_at);
   136→          duration = Math.ceil((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 1000); // in seconds
   137→        }
   138→
   139→        return {
   140→          id: task.id,
   141→          taskType: task.task_type,
   142→          status: task.status,
   143→          createdAt: task.created_at,
   144→          generationStartedAt: task.generation_started_at,
   145→          generationProcessedAt: task.generation_processed_at,
   146→          projectId: task.project_id,
   147→          projectName: projectLookup[task.project_id] || 'Unknown Project',
   148→          cost: costEntry ? Math.abs(costEntry.amount) : undefined,
   149→          duration,
   150→        };
   151→      });
   152→
   153→      // Apply cost filter (client-side since it depends on joined data)
   154→      if (filters.costFilter === 'free') {
   155→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => !task.cost || task.cost === 0);
   156→      } else if (filters.costFilter === 'paid') {
   157→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => task.cost && task.cost > 0);
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Get available filter options
   161→      // Use visible task types from centralized config (same as TasksPane dropdown)
   162→      // Show ALL visible types, not just ones user has used (matches TasksPane behavior)
   163→      const visibleTaskTypes = getVisibleTaskTypes();
   164→      
   165→      // Query for unique statuses from user's visible tasks
   166→      let allTasksQuery = supabase().from('tasks')
   167→        .select('task_type, status, project_id')
   168→        .in('project_id', projectIds);
   169→      
   170→      if (hiddenTaskTypes.length > 0) {
   171→        allTasksQuery = allTasksQuery.not('task_type', 'in', `(${hiddenTaskTypes.join(',')})`);
   172→      }
   173→      
   174→      const { data: allTasks } = await allTasksQuery;
   175→
   176→      const availableFilters = {

   178→        taskTypes: visibleTaskTypes.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)),
   179→        projects: projects,
   180→        statuses: [...new Set((allTasks || []).map(t => t.status))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
   181→      };
   182→
   183→      const total = count || 0;
   184→      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
   185→      const hasMore = page < totalPages;
   186→
   187→      return {
   188→        tasks,
   189→        pagination: {
   190→          limit,
   191→          offset,
   192→          total,
   193→          hasMore,
   194→          totalPages,
   195→          currentPage: page,
   196→        },
   197→        availableFilters
   198→      };
   199→    },
   200→  });
   201→}

    47→        query = query.in('task_type', filters.taskTypes);

    49→      if (filters.projectIds && filters.projectIds.length > 0) {

    53→      const { data: tasksData, error: tasksError } = await query
    54→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    55→
    56→      if (tasksError) {

    60→      const taskIds = tasksData?.map(task => task.id) || [];
    61→      const costsData = await fetchTaskLogCosts(taskIds);

    91→
    92→      // Convert to CSV
    93→      const headers = ['ID', 'Date', 'Task Type', 'Project', 'Status', 'Duration', 'Cost'];
    94→      const csvContent = [
    95→        headers.join(','),
    96→        ...tasks.map(task => [
    97→          task.id,
    98→          task.date,
    99→          `"${task.taskType}"`,
   100→          `"${task.project}"`,
   101→          task.status,
   102→          task.duration,
   103→          task.cost
   104→        ].join(','))
   105→      ].join('\n');
   106→
   107→      // Download file
   108→      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
   109→      const link = document.createElement('a');
   110→      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   111→      link.setAttribute('href', url);
   112→      link.setAttribute('download', `task-log-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`);
   113→      link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
   114→      document.body.appendChild(link);
   115→      link.click();
   116→      document.body.removeChild(link);
   117→
   118→    } catch (error) {
   119→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useTaskLogDownload', showToast: false });
   120→    } finally {
   121→      setIsDownloading(false);
   122→    }
   123→  }, [filters]);
   124→
   125→  return {
   126→    isDownloading,
   127→    handleDownload,
   128→  };
   129→}
   130→

1→/**
     2→ * Utility for extracting poster images (first frame) from video files
     3→ */
     4→
     5→import {
     6→  configureVideoForFrameCapture,
     7→  createVideoFrameCaptureElements,
     8→} from './videoFrameCapturePrimitives';
     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Extract the first frame of a video as a Blob
    12→ * @param videoFile The video file to extract from
    13→ * @returns Promise that resolves to a Blob of the poster image (JPEG)
    14→ */
    15→export function extractVideoPosterFrame(videoFile: File): Promise<Blob> {
    16→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    17→    const captureElements = createVideoFrameCaptureElements();
    18→    if (!captureElements) {
    19→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    20→      return;
    21→    }
    22→    const { video, canvas, ctx } = captureElements;
    23→
    24→    configureVideoForFrameCapture(video);
    25→
    26→    // When metadata is loaded, we can get dimensions
    27→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    28→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    29→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    30→      
    31→      // Seek to a small time to avoid black frames at the start
    32→      video.currentTime = 0.1;
    33→    });
    34→
    35→    // When we've seeked to the right time, capture the frame
    36→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    37→      try {
    38→        // Draw the video frame to canvas
    39→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    40→        
    41→        // Convert canvas to blob
    42→        canvas.toBlob(
    43→          (blob) => {
    44→            if (blob) {
    45→              resolve(blob);
    46→            } else {
    47→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    48→            }
    49→            
    50→            // Cleanup
    51→            video.src = '';
    52→            URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
    53→          },
    54→          'image/jpeg',
    55→          0.85 // Quality
    56→        );
    57→      } catch (error) {
    58→        reject(error);
    59→      }
    60→    });
    61→
    62→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    63→      reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
    64→    });
    65→
    66→    // Load the video
    67→    video.src = URL.createObjectURL(videoFile);
    68→  });
    69→}

   109→            }
   110→            
   111→            // Cleanup

   125→    });

1→/**
     2→ * Video Thumbnail Generator
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracts thumbnails from videos on the client side and uploads them to storage.
     5→ * This is used to generate missing thumbnails for videos that don't have them.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     9→import { getDisplayUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    10→import { storagePaths, MEDIA_BUCKET } from '@/shared/lib/storagePaths';
    11→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    12→import {
    13→  configureVideoForFrameCapture,
    14→  createVideoFrameCaptureElements,
    15→} from './videoFrameCapturePrimitives';
    16→
    17→interface ThumbnailGenerationResult {
    18→  success: boolean;
    19→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
    20→  error?: string;
    21→}
    22→
    23→interface ThumbnailExtractResult {
    24→  success: boolean;
    25→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
    26→  error?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→export async function resolveAuthenticatedMediaUserId(): Promise<string> {
    30→  const {
    31→    data: { session },
    32→  } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
    33→  if (!session?.user?.id) {
    34→    throw new Error('User not authenticated');
    35→  }
    36→  return session.user.id;
    37→}
    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Extracts a thumbnail from a video at a specific time
    41→ */
    42→function extractThumbnailFromVideo(
    43→  videoUrl: string,
    44→  timeInSeconds: number = 0.001
    45→): Promise<Blob> {
    46→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    47→    const captureElements = createVideoFrameCaptureElements();
    48→    if (!captureElements) {
    49→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    50→      return;
    51→    }
    52→    const { video, canvas, ctx } = captureElements;
    53→
    54→    configureVideoForFrameCapture(video, 'anonymous');
    55→
    56→    // Handle video loaded
    57→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    58→      // Set canvas size to video dimensions (or max 1280px width)
    59→      const maxWidth = 1280;
    60→      const scale = Math.min(1, maxWidth / video.videoWidth);
    61→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth * scale;
    62→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight * scale;
    63→
    64→      // Seek to the desired time (or start if video is shorter)
    65→      video.currentTime = Math.min(timeInSeconds, video.duration - 0.1);
    66→    });
    67→
    68→    // Handle seeked event
    69→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    70→      try {
    71→        // Draw video frame to canvas
    72→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    73→
    74→        // Convert to blob (JPEG, 85% quality)
    75→        canvas.toBlob(
    76→          (blob) => {
    77→            video.remove();
    78→            if (blob) {
    79→              resolve(blob);
    80→            } else {
    81→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    82→            }
    83→          },
    84→          'image/jpeg',
    85→          0.85
    86→        );
    87→      } catch (error) {
    88→        video.remove();
    89→        reject(error);
    90→      }
    91→    });
    92→
    93→    // Handle errors
    94→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    95→      video.remove();
    96→      reject(new Error(`Video loading failed: ${video.error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`));
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    // Start loading
   100→    video.src = getDisplayUrl(videoUrl);
   101→  });
   102→}
   103→
   104→/**
   105→ * Uploads a thumbnail blob to Supabase storage
   106→ * Note: projectId param kept for backwards compatibility but no longer used in path
   107→ */
   108→async function uploadThumbnailToStorage(
   109→  blob: Blob,
   110→  generationId: string,
   111→  _projectId: string
   112→): Promise<string> {
   113→  const userId = await resolveAuthenticatedMediaUserId();
   114→
   115→  const fileName = `${generationId}-thumb.jpg`;
   116→  const filePath = storagePaths.thumbnail(userId, fileName);
   117→
   118→  const { error } = await supabase().storage
   119→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   120→    .upload(filePath, blob, {
   121→      contentType: 'image/jpeg',
   122→      upsert: true, // Overwrite if exists
   123→    });
   124→
   125→  if (error) {
   126→    console.error('[ThumbnailGenerator] Upload failed:', error);
   127→    throw error;
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  // Get public URL
   131→  const { data: urlData } = supabase().storage
   132→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   133→    .getPublicUrl(filePath);
   134→
   135→  return urlData.publicUrl;
   136→}
   137→
   138→/**
   139→ * Updates the generation record with the new thumbnail URL
   140→ */
   141→async function updateGenerationThumbnail(
   142→  generationId: string,
   143→  thumbnailUrl: string
   144→): Promise<void> {
   145→
   146→  const { error } = await supabase().from('generations')
   147→    .update({ thumbnail_url: thumbnailUrl })
   148→    .eq('id', generationId);
   149→
   150→  if (error) {
   151→    console.error('[ThumbnailGenerator] Database update failed:', error);
   152→    throw error;
   153→  }
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Main function: Generates and uploads a thumbnail for a video
   158→ */
   159→export async function generateAndUploadThumbnail(
   160→  videoUrl: string,
   161→  generationId: string,
   162→  projectId: string
   163→): Promise<ThumbnailGenerationResult> {
   164→  try {
   165→
   166→    // Step 1: Extract thumbnail from video (first frame)
   167→    const thumbnailBlob = await extractThumbnailFromVideo(videoUrl, 0.001);
   168→
   169→    // Step 2: Upload to storage
   170→    const thumbnailUrl = await uploadThumbnailToStorage(thumbnailBlob, generationId, projectId);
   171→
   172→    // Step 3: Update database
   173→    await updateGenerationThumbnail(generationId, thumbnailUrl);
   174→
   175→    return {
   176→      success: true,
   177→      thumbnailUrl,
   178→    };
   179→  } catch (error) {
   180→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'VideoThumbnailGenerator', showToast: false });
   181→
   182→    return {
   183→      success: false,
   184→      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   185→    };
   186→  }
   187→}
   188→
   189→/**
   190→ * Extract and upload thumbnail only (no database update)
   191→ * Use this for variants where you'll update the record yourself
   192→ */
   193→export async function extractAndUploadThumbnailOnly(
   194→  videoUrl: string,
   195→  uniqueId: string,
   196→  projectId: string
   197→): Promise<ThumbnailExtractResult> {
   198→  try {
   199→
   200→    // Step 1: Extract thumbnail from video (first frame)
   201→    const thumbnailBlob = await extractThumbnailFromVideo(videoUrl, 0.001);
   202→    
   203→    // Step 2: Upload to storage

   205→    
   206→    return {

   212→
   213→    return {

1→interface VideoFrameCaptureElements {
     2→  video: HTMLVideoElement;
     3→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
     4→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D;

     6→
     7→export function createVideoFrameCaptureElements(): VideoFrameCaptureElements | null {
     8→  const video = document.createElement('video');
     9→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    10→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    11→
    12→  if (!ctx) {
    13→    return null;
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  return { video, canvas, ctx };
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function configureVideoForFrameCapture(video: HTMLVideoElement, crossOrigin?: string): void {
    20→  if (crossOrigin) {
    21→    video.crossOrigin = crossOrigin;
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  video.preload = 'metadata';
    25→  video.muted = true;
    26→  video.playsInline = true;
