1→import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  createTimelineWriteQueueLogger,
     7→  runSerializedTimelineWrite,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/timelineWriteQueue';
     9→import {
    10→  findGeneration,
    11→  calculateDistributedFrames,
    12→  deduplicateUpdates,
    13→  buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions,
    14→} from './timelineFrameCalculators';
    15→import {
    16→  buildCanonicalTimelineUpdates,
    17→  persistSingleTimelineFrame,
    18→  persistTimelineFrameBatchUpdates,
    19→  refetchTimelineFrameCaches,
    20→  syncTimelineGenerationFrames,
    21→} from './timelineMutationService';
    22→
    23→const TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX = '[TimelineFramePersist]';
    24→const log = import.meta.env.DEV ? (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => console.log(...args) : () => {};
    25→
    26→function shortTimelineFrameId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    27→  return value ? value.slice(0, 8) : null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→// Types
    32→// ============================================================================
    33→
    34→interface UseTimelineFrameUpdatesOptions {
    35→  shotId: string | null;
    36→  projectId?: string | null;
    37→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    38→  syncShotData: (generationId: string, targetShotId: string, frame: number) => Promise<void>;
    39→}
    40→
    41→// ============================================================================
    42→// Hook
    43→// ============================================================================
    44→
    45→export function useTimelineFrameUpdates({
    46→  shotId,
    47→  projectId,
    48→  shotGenerations,
    49→  syncShotData,
    50→}: UseTimelineFrameUpdatesOptions) {
    51→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    52→
    53→  // Always-current ref for shotGenerations. Set during render (not in a
    54→  // useEffect) so that any queued task that was blocked behind a slow write
    55→  // reads the up-to-date DB state when it actually executes rather than the
    56→  // stale snapshot captured when it was enqueued.
    57→  const shotGenerationsRef = useRef(shotGenerations);
    58→  shotGenerationsRef.current = shotGenerations;
    59→
    60→  const logQueuePhase = useMemo(
    61→    () => createTimelineWriteQueueLogger({ logPrefix: TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX, log }),
    62→    [],
    63→  );
    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Update timeline frame for a single generation
    67→   */
    68→  const updateTimelineFrame = useCallback(async (shotGenerationId: string, frame: number) => {
    69→    if (!shotId) {
    70→      throw new Error('No shotId provided');
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    await runSerializedTimelineWrite(
    74→      shotId,
    75→      'timeline-frame-single-update',
    76→      async (signal) => {
    77→
    78→        const live = shotGenerationsRef.current;
    79→        const shotGen = live.find((sg) => sg.id === shotGenerationId)
    80→          ?? live.find((sg) => sg.generation_id === shotGenerationId);
    81→        if (!shotGen?.id) {
    82→          normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(`Shot generation not found for ${shotGenerationId}`), {
    83→            context: 'TimelineFrameUpdates:updateTimelineFrame',
    84→            showToast: false,
    85→          });
    86→          throw new Error(`Shot generation not found for ${shotGenerationId}`);
    87→        }
    88→
    89→        await persistSingleTimelineFrame({
    90→          shotId,
    91→          shotGenerationId: shotGen.id,
    92→          frame,
    93→          signal,
    94→          logPrefix: TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX,
    95→          log,
    96→        });
    97→
    98→        if (shotGen.generation_id) {
    99→          await syncTimelineGenerationFrames({
   100→            shotId,
   101→            targets: [{ generationId: shotGen.generation_id, frame }],
   102→            syncShotData,
   103→            signal,
   104→            logPrefix: TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX,
   105→            log,
   106→          });
   107→        }
   108→
   109→        await refetchTimelineFrameCaches({ queryClient, shotId, projectId });
   110→      },
   111→      logQueuePhase,
   112→    );
   113→  }, [shotId, queryClient, projectId, syncShotData, logQueuePhase]);
   114→
   115→  /**
   116→   * Persist absolute frame updates for one or more shot_generations.
   117→   * Uses a single RPC write so reorders are atomic and easier to reason about.
   118→   */
   119→  const batchExchangePositions = useCallback(async (
   120→    updates: Array<{ shotGenerationId: string; newFrame: number }>
   121→  ) => {
   122→    if (!shotId) {
   123→      throw new Error('No shotId provided');
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    await runSerializedTimelineWrite(
   127→      shotId,
   128→      'timeline-frame-batch-exchange',
   129→      async (signal) => {
   130→
   131→        try {
   132→          if (updates.length === 0) {
   133→            return;
   134→          }
   135→
   136→          const canonicalUpdates = buildCanonicalTimelineUpdates({
   137→            updates,
   138→            shotGenerations: shotGenerationsRef.current,
   139→          });
   140→
   141→          if (canonicalUpdates.length === 0) {
   142→            return;
   143→          }
   144→
   145→          await persistTimelineFrameBatchUpdates({
   146→            shotId,
   147→            updates: canonicalUpdates.map(({ shotGenerationId, newFrame }) => ({
   148→              shotGenerationId,
   149→              timelineFrame: newFrame,
   150→            })),
   151→            operationLabel: 'timeline-frame-batch-exchange',
   152→            timeoutOperationName: 'timeline-frame-batch-rpc',
   153→            dragSource: 'batch-exchange',
   154→            signal,
   155→            logPrefix: TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX,
   156→            log,
   157→          });
   158→
   159→          await syncTimelineGenerationFrames({
   160→            shotId,
   161→            targets: canonicalUpdates.map(({ generationId, newFrame }) => ({
   162→              generationId,
   163→              frame: newFrame,
   164→            })),
   165→            syncShotData,
   166→            signal,
   167→            logPrefix: TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX,
   168→            log,
   169→            ignoreTimeout: true,
   170→          });
   171→
   172→          await refetchTimelineFrameCaches({
   173→            queryClient,
   174→            shotId,
   175→            projectId,
   176→            includeLiveTimeline: true,
   177→          });
   178→          log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} batchExchange cache refetch triggered`, {
   179→            shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   180→            changedCount: canonicalUpdates.length,
   181→            byShot: shotId,
   182→          });
   183→        } catch (error) {
   184→          log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} batchExchangePositions failed`, {
   185→            shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   186→            updateCount: updates.length,
   187→            error,
   188→          });
   189→          throw error;
   190→        }
   191→      },
   192→      logQueuePhase,
   193→    );
   194→  }, [shotId, queryClient, projectId, syncShotData, logQueuePhase]);
   195→
   196→  /**
   197→   * Move items to distributed positions between neighbors (for batch mode drag).
   198→   * Supports both single and multi-item moves.
   199→   */
   200→  const moveItemsToMidpoint = useCallback(async (
   201→    draggedItemIds: string[],
   202→    newStartIndex: number,
   203→    allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>
   204→  ) => {
   205→    if (!shotId) {
   206→      throw new Error('No shotId provided');
   207→    }
   208→
   209→    await runSerializedTimelineWrite(
   210→      shotId,
   211→      'timeline-frame-midpoint-move',
   212→      async (signal) => {
   213→
   214→        // Read the latest shotGenerations at execution time, not at enqueue
   215→        // time — this task may have waited in queue behind a slow write.
   216→        const liveShotGenerations = shotGenerationsRef.current;
   217→
   218→        // Find shot_generation records for all dragged items
   219→        const draggedShotGens = draggedItemIds.map(id => {
   220→          const sg = findGeneration(liveShotGenerations, id);
   221→          if (!sg?.id) {
   222→            throw new Error(`Shot generation not found for ${id}`);
   223→          }
   224→          return sg;
   225→        });
   226→
   227→        log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} midpoint calc start`, {
   228→          shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   229→          draggedCount: draggedItemIds.length,
   230→          allItemCount: allItems.length,
   231→          newStartIndex,
   232→          liveShotGenCount: liveShotGenerations.length,
   233→        });
   234→
   235→        // Calculate distributed frames (pure computation)
   236→        const rawUpdates = calculateDistributedFrames({
   237→          draggedShotGens,
   238→          draggedItemIds,
   239→          newStartIndex,
   240→          allItems,
   241→          shotGenerations: liveShotGenerations,
   242→        });
   243→
   244→        // Deduplicate, then normalize so the sequence always starts at frame 0.
   245→        // Without normalization, moving the first item (frame 0) later would
   246→        // leave the 0-slot empty because only the moved item gets a new frame
   247→        // assigned — all other items keep their existing DB values unchanged.
   248→        const uniqueUpdates = deduplicateUpdates(rawUpdates);
   249→        const normalizedUpdates = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(uniqueUpdates, liveShotGenerations);
   250→        const afterDedupCount = normalizedUpdates.size;
   251→
   252→        log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} midpoint calc result`, {
   253→          shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   254→          rawUpdateCount: rawUpdates.length,
   255→          afterDedupCount,
   256→        });
   257→
   258→        const rpcUpdates = Array.from(normalizedUpdates.entries()).map(([id, payload]) => ({
   259→          shotGenerationId: id,
   260→          timelineFrame: payload.newFrame,
   261→          metadata: {
   262→            user_positioned: true,
   263→            drag_source: 'batch-midpoint',
   264→          },
   265→        }));
   266→        const changedUpdates = rpcUpdates.filter((update) => {
   267→          const currentFrame = liveShotGenerations.find((sg) => sg.id === update.shotGenerationId)?.timeline_frame ?? null;
   268→          return currentFrame !== update.timelineFrame;
   269→        });
   270→        if (changedUpdates.length === 0) {
   271→          log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} midpoint rpc skipped (no frame changes)`, {
   272→            shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   273→            candidateCount: rpcUpdates.length,
   274→          });
   275→          return;
   276→        }
   277→
   278→        log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} midpoint persisting`, {
   279→          shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   280→          changedCount: changedUpdates.length,
   281→          unchangedCount: rpcUpdates.length - changedUpdates.length,
   282→          updates: changedUpdates.map(u => `${shortTimelineFrameId(u.shotGenerationId)}→${u.timelineFrame}`).join(', '),
   283→        });
   284→
   285→        try {
   286→          await persistTimelineFrameBatchUpdates({
   287→            shotId,
   288→            updates: changedUpdates.map((update) => ({
   289→              shotGenerationId: update.shotGenerationId,
   290→              timelineFrame: update.timelineFrame,
   291→            })),
   292→            operationLabel: 'timeline-frame-midpoint-move',
   293→            timeoutOperationName: 'timeline-frame-midpoint-rpc',
   294→            dragSource: 'batch-midpoint',
   295→            signal,
   296→            logPrefix: TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX,
   297→            log,
   298→          });
   299→        } catch (error) {
   300→          log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} midpoint persist failed`, {
   301→            shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   302→            changedCount: changedUpdates.length,
   303→            errorCode: (error as { code?: string }).code ?? null,
   304→            errorMessage: (error as Error).message ?? null,
   305→          });
   306→          throw error;
   307→        }
   308→
   309→        await refetchTimelineFrameCaches({
   310→          queryClient,
   311→          shotId,
   312→          projectId,
   313→          includeLiveTimeline: true,
   314→        });
   315→        log(`${TIMELINE_FRAME_LOG_PREFIX} midpoint cache refetch triggered`, {
   316→          shotId: shortTimelineFrameId(shotId),
   317→          changedCount: changedUpdates.length,
   318→          byShot: shotId,
   319→        });
   320→      },
   321→      logQueuePhase,
   322→    );
   323→  }, [shotId, queryClient, projectId, logQueuePhase]);
   324→
   325→  return {
   326→    updateTimelineFrame,
   327→    batchExchangePositions,
   328→    moveItemsToMidpoint,
   329→  };
   330→}

1→import type { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     2→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
     4→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
     5→import { persistTimelineFrameBatch } from '@/shared/lib/timelineFrameBatchPersist';
     6→import {
     7→  isTimelineWriteTimeoutError,
     8→  runTimelineWriteWithTimeout,
     9→} from '@/shared/lib/timelineWriteQueue';
    10→
    11→type TimelineLogFn = (...args: unknown[]) => void;
    12→
    13→function shortNullableId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    14→  return value ? value.slice(0, 8) : null;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface RefetchTimelineFrameCachesInput {
    18→  queryClient: QueryClient;
    19→  shotId: string;
    20→  projectId?: string | null;
    21→  includeLiveTimeline?: boolean;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export async function refetchTimelineFrameCaches({
    25→  queryClient,
    26→  shotId,
    27→  projectId,
    28→  includeLiveTimeline = false,
    29→}: RefetchTimelineFrameCachesInput): Promise<void> {
    30→  const refetchOperations: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [
    31→    queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) }),
    32→    queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) }),
    33→  ];
    34→  if (projectId) {
    35→    refetchOperations.push(
    36→      queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) }),
    37→    );
    38→  }
    39→  if (includeLiveTimeline) {
    40→    refetchOperations.push(
    41→      queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) }),
    42→    );
    43→  }
    44→  await Promise.all(refetchOperations);
    45→}
    46→
    47→interface PersistSingleTimelineFrameInput {
    48→  shotId: string;
    49→  shotGenerationId: string;
    50→  frame: number;
    51→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    52→  logPrefix: string;
    53→  log: TimelineLogFn;
    54→}
    55→
    56→export async function persistSingleTimelineFrame({
    57→  shotId,
    58→  shotGenerationId,
    59→  frame,
    60→  signal,
    61→  logPrefix,
    62→  log,
    63→}: PersistSingleTimelineFrameInput): Promise<void> {
    64→  await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
    65→    'timeline-frame-single-update-write',
    66→    async (signal) => {
    67→      const query = supabase().from('shot_generations')
    68→        .update({ timeline_frame: frame })
    69→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId)
    70→        .eq('shot_id', shotId);
    71→      const request = 'abortSignal' in query
    72→        ? query.abortSignal(signal)
    73→        : query;
    74→      const { error } = await request;
    75→      if (error) {
    76→        throw error;
    77→      }
    78→    },
    79→    {
    80→      upstreamSignal: signal,
    81→      onTimeout: ({ pendingMs, timeoutMs }) => {
    82→        log(`${logPrefix} updateTimelineFrame timed out`, {
    83→          shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
    84→          shotGenerationId: shortNullableId(shotGenerationId),
    85→          targetFrame: frame,
    86→          timeoutMs,
    87→          pendingMs,
    88→        });
    89→      },
    90→    },
    91→  );
    92→}
    93→
    94→interface CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate {
    95→  shotGenerationId: string;
    96→  generationId: string;
    97→  newFrame: number;
    98→}
    99→
   100→interface BuildCanonicalUpdatesInput {
   101→  updates: Array<{ shotGenerationId: string; newFrame: number }>;
   102→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
   103→}
   104→
   105→export function buildCanonicalTimelineUpdates({
   106→  updates,
   107→  shotGenerations,
   108→}: BuildCanonicalUpdatesInput): CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate[] {
   109→  return updates
   110→    .map(({ shotGenerationId, newFrame }) => {
   111→      const shotGen = shotGenerations.find((sg) => sg.id === shotGenerationId);
   112→      if (!shotGen?.id || !shotGen.generation_id) {
   113→        return null;
   114→      }
   115→      return {
   116→        shotGenerationId: shotGen.id,
   117→        generationId: shotGen.generation_id,
   118→        newFrame,
   119→      } satisfies CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate;
   120→    })
   121→    .filter((update): update is CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate => update !== null);
   122→}
   123→
   124→interface TimelineFrameBatchUpdate {
   125→  shotGenerationId: string;
   126→  timelineFrame: number;
   127→}
   128→
   129→interface PersistTimelineFrameBatchUpdatesInput {
   130→  shotId: string;
   131→  updates: TimelineFrameBatchUpdate[];
   132→  operationLabel: string;
   133→  timeoutOperationName: string;
   134→  dragSource: 'batch-exchange' | 'batch-midpoint';
   135→  signal?: AbortSignal;
   136→  logPrefix: string;
   137→  log: TimelineLogFn;
   138→}
   139→
   140→export async function persistTimelineFrameBatchUpdates({
   141→  shotId,
   142→  updates,
   143→  operationLabel,
   144→  timeoutOperationName,
   145→  dragSource,
   146→  signal,
   147→  logPrefix,
   148→  log,
   149→}: PersistTimelineFrameBatchUpdatesInput): Promise<void> {
   150→  await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   151→    shotId,
   152→    updates: updates.map((update) => ({
   153→      shotGenerationId: update.shotGenerationId,
   154→      timelineFrame: update.timelineFrame,
   155→      metadata: {
   156→        user_positioned: true,
   157→        drag_source: dragSource,
   158→      },
   159→    })),
   160→    operationLabel,
   161→    timeoutOperationName,
   162→    signal,
   163→    logPrefix,
   164→    log,
   165→  });
   166→}
   167→
   168→interface SyncTimelineGenerationFramesInput {
   169→  shotId: string;
   170→  targets: Array<{ generationId: string; frame: number }>;
   171→  syncShotData: (generationId: string, targetShotId: string, frame: number) => Promise<void>;
   172→  signal?: AbortSignal;
   173→  logPrefix: string;
   174→  log: TimelineLogFn;
   175→  ignoreTimeout?: boolean;
   176→}
   177→
   178→export async function syncTimelineGenerationFrames({
   179→  shotId,
   180→  targets,
   181→  syncShotData,
   182→  signal,
   183→  logPrefix,
   184→  log,
   185→  ignoreTimeout = false,
   186→}: SyncTimelineGenerationFramesInput): Promise<void> {
   187→  if (targets.length === 0) {
   188→    return;
   189→  }
   190→
   191→  try {
   192→    await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   193→      'timeline-frame-sync-shot-data',
   194→      async () => {
   195→        await Promise.all(
   196→          targets.map(({ generationId, frame }) => syncShotData(generationId, shotId, frame)),
   197→        );
   198→      },
   199→      {
   200→        timeoutMs: 10_000,
   201→        upstreamSignal: signal,
   202→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs, timeoutMs }) => {
   203→          log(`${logPrefix} shot_data sync timed out`, {
   204→            shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
   205→            syncCount: targets.length,
   206→            timeoutMs,
   207→            pendingMs,
   208→          });
   209→        },
   210→      },
   211→    );
   212→  } catch (error) {
   213→    if (ignoreTimeout && isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error)) {
   214→      log(`${logPrefix} shot_data sync timeout ignored`, {
   215→        shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
   216→        syncCount: targets.length,
   217→      });
   218→      return;
   219→    }
   220→    throw error;
   221→  }
   222→}

    39→function requireProjectScope(projectId: string): string {

    42→  }

    44→  throw new Error('Mutation requires project scope');

    47→function throwScopedMutationFailure(error: unknown, emptyMessage: string): never {
    48→  if (error instanceof Error) {
    49→    throw error;
    50→  }
    51→  if (
    52→    error &&
    53→    typeof error === 'object' &&
    54→    'message' in error &&
    55→    typeof (error as { message?: unknown }).message === 'string'
    56→  ) {
    57→    throw new Error((error as { message: string }).message);
    58→  }
    59→  throw new Error(emptyMessage);
    60→}

   117→}

   119→export async function createExternalUploadGeneration(
   120→  params: CreateExternalUploadGenerationInput,
   121→): Promise<GenerationRowDto & { params?: Json | null }> {
   122→  const projectId = requireProjectScope(params.projectId);
   123→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient()
   124→    .from('generations')
   125→    .insert({
   126→      location: params.imageUrl,
   127→      thumbnail_url: params.thumbnailUrl,
   128→      type: params.fileType,
   129→      project_id: projectId,
   130→      params: params.generationParams as unknown as Json,
   131→    })
   132→    .select()
   133→    .single();
   134→
   135→  if (error || !data) {

   137→  }

   139→  const { error: variantError } = await getSupabaseClient()
   140→    .from('generation_variants')

   142→      generation_id: data.id,
   143→      location: params.imageUrl,
   144→      thumbnail_url: params.thumbnailUrl,
   145→      is_primary: true,
   146→      variant_type: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   147→      name: 'Original',
   148→      params: params.generationParams as unknown as Json,
   149→    });
   150→
   151→  if (variantError) {

   153→  }
   154→
   155→  return data as GenerationRowDto & { params?: Json | null };
   156→}

1→/**
     2→ * useEffectiveMedia - Computes effective URLs and dimensions for media display
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles:
     5→ * - effectiveVideoUrl: Video URL respecting active variant
     6→ * - effectiveMediaUrl: Image URL respecting active variant
     7→ * - effectiveImageDimensions: Guaranteed dimensions with fallbacks
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useMemo } from 'react';
    11→import { ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION } from '@/shared/lib/media/aspectRatios';
    12→import { resolutionToDimensions } from '../utils/dimensions';
    13→
    14→interface UseEffectiveMediaProps {
    15→  isVideo: boolean;
    16→  activeVariant: {
    17→    id?: string | null;
    18→    location?: string | null;
    19→    thumbnail_url?: string | null;
    20→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    21→  } | null;
    22→  effectiveImageUrl: string | undefined;
    23→  imageDimensions: { width: number; height: number } | null;
    24→  projectAspectRatio: string | undefined;
    25→}
    26→
    27→interface UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    28→  effectiveVideoUrl: string | undefined;
    29→  effectiveMediaUrl: string | undefined;
    30→  effectiveImageDimensions: { width: number; height: number };
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function useEffectiveMedia({
    34→  isVideo,
    35→  activeVariant,
    36→  effectiveImageUrl,
    37→  imageDimensions,
    38→  projectAspectRatio,
    39→}: UseEffectiveMediaProps): UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    40→  // Get the effective video URL (active variant or current media)
    41→  const effectiveVideoUrl = useMemo(() => {
    42→    if (isVideo && activeVariant) {
    43→      return activeVariant.location ?? undefined;
    44→    }
    45→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    46→  }, [isVideo, activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    47→
    48→  // For images, use the active variant's location when a variant is explicitly selected
    49→  const effectiveMediaUrl = useMemo(() => {
    50→
    51→    // If an active variant is set (any variant, including primary), use its location
    52→    if (activeVariant && activeVariant.location) {
    53→      return activeVariant.location;
    54→    }
    55→    // Otherwise use the standard effective image URL
    56→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    57→  }, [activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    58→
    59→  // Compute effective dimensions that are GUARANTEED to have a value
    60→  // This is computed synchronously during render, so there's no flicker
    61→  // Priority: extracted/loaded dimensions > project aspect ratio > 16:9 default
    62→  const effectiveImageDimensions = useMemo(() => {
    63→    // Use actual dimensions if we have them
    64→    if (imageDimensions) {
    65→      return imageDimensions;
    66→    }
    67→
    68→    // Fallback to project aspect ratio
    69→    if (projectAspectRatio) {
    70→      const resolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[projectAspectRatio];
    71→      if (resolution) {
    72→        const dimensions = resolutionToDimensions(resolution);
    73→        if (dimensions) {
    74→          return dimensions;
    75→        }
    76→      }
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    // Absolute last resort: 16:9 default
    80→    return { width: 1920, height: 1080 };
    81→  }, [imageDimensions, projectAspectRatio]);
    82→
    83→  return {
    84→    effectiveVideoUrl,
    85→    effectiveMediaUrl,
    86→    effectiveImageDimensions,
    87→  };
    88→}
    89→

1→import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import type { UseMutationResult } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import { useToggleGenerationStar } from '@/domains/generation/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     4→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     5→import { getGenerationId } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
     6→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';
     7→
     8→interface UseStarToggleProps {
     9→  media: GenerationRow;
    10→  starred?: boolean;
    11→  shotId?: string;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseStarToggleReturn {
    15→  localStarred: boolean;
    16→  setLocalStarred: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
    17→  toggleStarMutation: UseMutationResult<void, Error, { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }>;
    18→  handleToggleStar: () => void;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for managing star toggle state
    23→ * Maintains local state for immediate UI updates while syncing with server
    24→ */
    25→export const useStarToggle = ({ media, starred, shotId }: UseStarToggleProps): UseStarToggleReturn => {
    26→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    27→  const toggleStarMutation = useToggleGenerationStar();
    28→  
    29→  // Track when we last mutated to prevent stale prop syncing
    30→  const lastMutationTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
    31→  const prevMediaIdRef = useRef<string>(media.id);
    32→
    33→  // Local starred state to ensure UI reflects updates immediately even if parent data is stale
    34→  const initialStarred = useMemo(() => {
    35→    // Prefer explicit prop, fall back to media.starred if available
    36→    
    37→    if (typeof starred === 'boolean') {
    38→      return starred;
    39→    }
    40→    if (typeof media.starred === 'boolean') {
    41→      return media.starred;
    42→    }
    43→    return false;
    44→  }, [starred, media.starred]);
    45→
    46→  const [localStarred, setLocalStarred] = useState<boolean>(initialStarred);
    47→
    48→  // Keep local state in sync when parent updates (e.g., after query refetch or navigating to different image)
    49→  // BUT: Don't sync if we recently performed a mutation (prevents stale prop from resetting UI)
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    const mediaChanged = prevMediaIdRef.current !== media.id;
    52→    const timeSinceMutation = Date.now() - lastMutationTimeRef.current;
    53→    const recentlyMutated = timeSinceMutation < 2000; // 2 second grace period
    54→    const willSync = mediaChanged || !recentlyMutated;
    55→    
    56→    // Only sync if:
    57→    // 1. Media changed (navigated to different image), OR
    58→    // 2. Haven't recently mutated (prevents stale prop from overriding optimistic update)
    59→    if (willSync) {
    60→      setLocalStarred(initialStarred);
    61→    }
    62→    
    63→    prevMediaIdRef.current = media.id;
    64→  }, [initialStarred, media.id]);
    65→
    66→  // Handler that records mutation time to prevent stale prop syncing
    67→  const handleToggleStar = () => {
    68→    const newStarred = !localStarred;
    69→    
    70→    // Record mutation time BEFORE updating state
    71→    lastMutationTimeRef.current = Date.now();
    72→    
    73→    // Optimistically update UI
    74→    setLocalStarred(newStarred);
    75→    
    76→    // IMPORTANT: Use generation_id (actual generations.id) when available, falling back to id
    77→    // For ShotImageManager/Timeline images, id is shot_generations.id but generation_id is the actual generation ID
    78→    // For variants, generation_id is in metadata.generation_id (the parent generation)
    79→    const actualGenerationId = getGenerationId(media);
    80→    
    81→    // Trigger mutation
    82→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    83→      setLocalStarred((prev) => !prev);
    84→      return;
    85→    }
    86→    toggleStarMutation.mutate({
    87→      id: actualGenerationId ?? media.id,
    88→      starred: newStarred,
    89→      projectId: selectedProjectId,
    90→      shotId,
    91→    });
    92→  };
    93→
    94→  return {
    95→    localStarred,
    96→    setLocalStarred,
    97→    toggleStarMutation,
    98→    handleToggleStar,
    99→  };
   100→};
   101→

1→interface VariantRow {
     2→  id: string;
     3→  generation_id: string;
     4→  location: string;
     5→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
     6→  is_primary: boolean;
     7→}
     8→
     9→type GenerationRecord = Record<string, unknown> & {
    10→  id: string;
    11→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
    12→};
    13→
    14→interface VariantGenerationLookupResult {
    15→  generation: GenerationRecord;
    16→  variantId: string;
    17→  variantIsPrimary: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→interface SupabaseLike {
    21→  from: (table: string) => unknown;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export async function findGenerationByVariantLocation(
    25→  outputLocation: string,
    26→  supabaseClient: SupabaseLike,
    27→): Promise<VariantGenerationLookupResult | null> {
    28→  const { data: variantByLocation, error: variantError } = await (supabaseClient.from('generation_variants') as {
    29→    select: (columns: string) => {
    30→      eq: (column: string, value: string) => {
    31→        limit: (count: number) => Promise<{ data: VariantRow[] | null; error: unknown }>;
    32→      };
    33→    };
    34→  })
    35→    .select('id, generation_id, location, thumbnail_url, is_primary')
    36→    .eq('location', outputLocation)
    37→    .limit(1);
    38→
    39→  if (variantError || !variantByLocation || variantByLocation.length === 0) {
    40→    return null;
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const variant = variantByLocation[0];
    44→  const { data: parentGen, error: parentError } = await (supabaseClient.from('generations') as {
    45→    select: (columns: string) => {
    46→      eq: (column: string, value: string) => {
    47→        single: () => Promise<{ data: GenerationRecord | null; error: unknown }>;
    48→      };
    49→    };
    50→  })
    51→    .select('*')
    52→    .eq('id', variant.generation_id)
    53→    .single();
    54→
    55→  if (parentError || !parentGen) {
    56→    return null;
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  const generation = parentGen;
    60→  return {
    61→    generation: {
    62→      ...generation,
    63→      location: variant.location,
    64→      thumbnail_url: variant.thumbnail_url || generation.thumbnail_url,
    65→    },
    66→    variantId: variant.id,
    67→    variantIsPrimary: variant.is_primary,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→

1→interface RealtimeClientWithInstrumentation {
     2→  socket: WebSocket | null;
     3→  conn?: { transport?: { ws?: WebSocket | null } };
     4→  __REFERENCE_TRACKING_INSTALLED__?: boolean;
     5→}
     6→
     7→interface InstallRealtimeReferencePatchersInput {
     8→  realtime: RealtimeClientWithInstrumentation;
     9→  captureSnapshot: () => unknown;
    10→  reportCorruption: (message: string, logData: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    11→  recordEvent: (event: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    12→  getTimelineSnapshot: () => unknown[];
    13→}
    14→
    15→export function installRealtimeReferencePatchers({
    16→  realtime,
    17→  captureSnapshot,
    18→  reportCorruption,
    19→  recordEvent,
    20→  getTimelineSnapshot,
    21→}: InstallRealtimeReferencePatchersInput): void {
    22→  if (realtime.__REFERENCE_TRACKING_INSTALLED__) {
    23→    return;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let trackedSocket = realtime.socket;
    27→  Object.defineProperty(realtime, 'socket', {
    28→    get() {
    29→      return trackedSocket;
    30→    },
    31→    set(value) {
    32→      const before = captureSnapshot();
    33→
    34→      if (trackedSocket && !value) {
    35→        reportCorruption('[RealtimeCorruptionTrace] realtime.socket set to null', {
    36→          previousValue: trackedSocket,
    37→          newValue: value,
    38→          stackTrace: new Error().stack,
    39→          realtimeStateBefore: before,
    40→          corruptionTimeline: getTimelineSnapshot(),
    41→          timestamp: Date.now(),
    42→        });
    43→        recordEvent('SOCKET_SET_TO_NULL', {
    44→          previousValue: trackedSocket,
    45→          newValue: value,
    46→        });
    47→      } else if (!trackedSocket && value) {
    48→        recordEvent('SOCKET_SET_TO_WEBSOCKET', { newValue: value });
    49→      } else if (trackedSocket !== value) {
    50→        reportCorruption('[RealtimeCorruptionTrace] realtime.socket replaced', {
    51→          previousValue: trackedSocket,
    52→          newValue: value,
    53→          stackTrace: new Error().stack,
    54→          realtimeStateBefore: before,
    55→          timestamp: Date.now(),
    56→        });
    57→        recordEvent('SOCKET_REPLACED', {
    58→          previousValue: trackedSocket,
    59→          newValue: value,
    60→        });
    61→      }

     4→  StructureVideoConfigWithLegacyGuidance,

     8→
     9→type StructureType = 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth';
    10→
    11→export interface ResolveTravelStructureStateOptions {
    12→  defaultEndFrame: number;
    13→  defaultVideoTreatment: 'adjust' | 'clip';
    14→  defaultMotionStrength: number;
    15→  defaultStructureType: StructureType;
    16→  defaultUni3cEndPercent: number;
    17→}
    18→
    19→export interface ResolvedTravelStructureState {
    20→  structureVideos: StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata[];
    21→  structureGuidance?: StructureGuidanceConfig;
    22→}
    23→
    24→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    25→  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    26→    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
    27→    : null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→function parseString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
    31→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
    32→}
    33→
    34→function parseNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    35→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    36→}
    37→
    38→function parseTreatment(value: unknown): 'adjust' | 'clip' | undefined {
    39→  return value === 'adjust' || value === 'clip' ? value : undefined;
    40→}
    41→
    42→function buildMigrationInput(value: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    43→  const structureVideos = value.structure_videos ?? value.structureVideos;
    44→  if (Array.isArray(structureVideos)) {
    45→    return {
    46→      ...value,
    47→      structure_videos: structureVideos,
    48→    };
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  const structureVideo = asRecord(value.structureVideo);
    52→  if (structureVideo) {
    53→    return structureVideo;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  return value;
    57→}
    58→
    59→function mergeStructureVideos(
    60→  rawVideos: StructureVideoConfigWithLegacyGuidance[],
    61→  structureGuidance: StructureGuidanceConfig | undefined,
    62→  options: ResolveTravelStructureStateOptions,
    63→): StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata[] {
    64→  const guidanceVideos = Array.isArray(structureGuidance?.videos)
    65→    ? structureGuidance.videos
    66→        .map((video) => asRecord(video))
    67→        .filter((video): video is Record<string, unknown> => !!video)
    68→    : [];
    69→  const sourceVideos = guidanceVideos.length > 0 ? guidanceVideos : rawVideos;
    70→
    71→  return sourceVideos
    72→    .map((video, index) => {
    73→      const path = parseString(video.path);
    74→      if (!path) {
    75→        return null;
    76→      }
    77→
    78→      const rawVideo = rawVideos[index];
    79→      return {
    80→        path,
    81→        start_frame: parseNumber(video.start_frame) ?? rawVideo?.start_frame ?? 0,
    82→        end_frame: parseNumber(video.end_frame) ?? rawVideo?.end_frame ?? options.defaultEndFrame,
    83→        treatment: parseTreatment(video.treatment) ?? rawVideo?.treatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
    84→        ...(parseNumber(video.source_start_frame) !== undefined || rawVideo?.source_start_frame !== undefined
    85→          ? { source_start_frame: parseNumber(video.source_start_frame) ?? rawVideo?.source_start_frame }
    86→          : {}),
    87→        ...(video.source_end_frame === null || rawVideo?.source_end_frame === null || parseNumber(video.source_end_frame) !== undefined || rawVideo?.source_end_frame !== undefined
    88→          ? { source_end_frame: parseNumber(video.source_end_frame) ?? rawVideo?.source_end_frame ?? null }
    89→          : {}),
    90→        metadata: rawVideo?.metadata ?? null,
    91→        resource_id: rawVideo?.resource_id ?? null,
    92→      } satisfies StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata;
    93→    })
    94→    .filter((video): video is StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata => video !== null);
    95→}
    96→
    97→export function resolveTravelStructureState(
    98→  value: unknown,
    99→  options: ResolveTravelStructureStateOptions,
   100→): ResolvedTravelStructureState {
   101→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   102→  if (!settings) {
   103→    return { structureVideos: [] };
   104→  }
   105→
   106→  const migratedStructureVideos = migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   107→    buildMigrationInput(settings),
   108→    {
   109→      defaultEndFrame: options.defaultEndFrame,
   110→      defaultVideoTreatment: options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   111→      defaultMotionStrength: options.defaultMotionStrength,
   112→      defaultStructureType: options.defaultStructureType,
   113→      defaultUni3cEndPercent: options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   114→    },
   115→  );
   116→
   117→  const structureGuidance = normalizeStructureGuidance({
   118→    structureGuidance: settings.structure_guidance ?? settings.structureGuidance,
   119→    structureVideos: migratedStructureVideos,
   120→    defaultVideoTreatment: options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   121→    defaultUni3cEndPercent: options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   122→  }) as StructureGuidanceConfig | undefined;
   123→
   124→  const structureVideos = mergeStructureVideos(
   125→    migratedStructureVideos,
   126→    structureGuidance,
   127→    options,
   128→  );
   129→
   130→  return {
   131→    structureVideos,
   132→    ...(structureGuidance ? { structureGuidance } : {}),
   133→  };
   134→}
   135→

1→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→
     3→export type RepositoryErrorCode = 'query_failed' | 'invalid_row_shape';
     4→
     5→interface RepositoryErrorOptions {
     6→  cause?: unknown;
     7→  context?: Record<string, unknown>;
     8→}
     9→
    10→function toError(cause: unknown): Error | undefined {
    11→  if (cause instanceof Error) {
    12→    return cause;
    13→  }
    14→  if (cause == null) {
    15→    return undefined;
    16→  }
    17→  return new Error(typeof cause === 'string' ? cause : JSON.stringify(cause));
    18→}
    19→
    20→export class RepositoryError extends ServerError {
    21→  readonly code: RepositoryErrorCode;
    22→
    23→  constructor(
    24→    code: RepositoryErrorCode,
    25→    message: string,
    26→    options: RepositoryErrorOptions = {},
    27→  ) {
    28→    super(message, {
    29→      cause: toError(options.cause),
    30→      context: options.context,
    31→    });
    32→    this.name = 'RepositoryError';
    33→    this.code = code;
    34→  }
    35→}
    36→
    37→export function isRepositoryNoRowsError(error: unknown): boolean {
    38→  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
    39→    return false;
    40→  }
    41→  const candidate = error as { code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
    42→  if (candidate.code === 'PGRST116') {
    43→    return true;
    44→  }
    45→  return typeof candidate.message === 'string' && /0 rows/i.test(candidate.message);
    46→}
    47→
    48→export function createRepositoryQueryError(
    49→  entityName: string,
    50→  cause: unknown,
    51→  context: Record<string, unknown>,
    52→): RepositoryError {
    53→  const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
    54→  return new RepositoryError(
    55→    'query_failed',
    56→    `Failed to fetch ${entityName}: ${message}`,
    57→    { cause, context },
    58→  );
    59→}
    60→
    61→export function createInvalidRowShapeError(
    62→  entityName: string,
    63→  context: Record<string, unknown>,
    64→): RepositoryError {
    65→  return new RepositoryError(
    66→    'invalid_row_shape',
    67→    `${entityName} row has unexpected shape`,
    68→    { context },
    69→  );
    70→}

    18→/**
    19→ * Hook to fetch video generations for video tasks
    20→ * Only fetches when hovering (lazy loading to avoid query spam)
    21→ */
    22→export function useVideoGenerations({
    23→  task,
    24→  taskParams,
    25→  isVideoTask,
    26→  isCompletedVideoTask,
    27→  isHovering,
    28→}: UseVideoGenerationsOptions) {
    29→  // State to control when to fetch video generations (on hover)
    30→  const [shouldFetchVideo, setShouldFetchVideo] = useState(false);
    31→
    32→  // State to track if user clicked the button (not just hovered)
    33→  const [waitingForVideoToOpen, setWaitingForVideoToOpen] = useState(false);
    34→
    35→  // Trigger video fetch when hovering over completed video tasks
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (isHovering && isCompletedVideoTask && !shouldFetchVideo) {
    38→      setShouldFetchVideo(true);
    39→    }
    40→  }, [isHovering, isCompletedVideoTask, shouldFetchVideo, task.id]);
    41→
    42→  // Fetch video generations
    43→  const { data: videoGenerations, isLoading: isLoadingVideoGen } = useQuery({
    44→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.videoForTask(task.id), task.outputLocation],
    45→    queryFn: async () => {
    46→
    47→      if (!isVideoTask || task.status !== 'Complete') {
    48→        return null;
    49→      }
    50→
    51→      // For individual_travel_segment tasks with child_generation_id, fetch that generation directly
    52→      const childGenerationId =
    53→        typeof taskParams.parsed?.child_generation_id === 'string'
    54→          ? taskParams.parsed.child_generation_id
    55→          : null;
    56→      if (task.taskType === 'individual_travel_segment' && childGenerationId) {
    57→        const { data: childGen, error: childError } = await supabase().from('generations')
    58→          .select('*, generation_variants(*)')
    59→          .eq('id', childGenerationId)
    60→          .single();

     8→ * Usage:

    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });

    62→  private summarizeConsoleContext(context?: LogContext): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
    63→    if (!context) {
    64→      return undefined;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    const allowedKeys = [
    68→      'task_id',
    69→      'shot_id',
    70→      'user_id',
    71→      'error',
    72→      'status',
    73→      'status_code',
    74→      'method',
    75→      'repoId',
    76→      'count',
    77→    ] as const;
    78→
    79→    const summaryEntries = allowedKeys
    80→      .filter((key) => context[key] !== undefined)
    81→      .map((key) => [key, context[key]] as const);
    82→
    83→    if (summaryEntries.length === 0) {
    84→      return undefined;
    85→    }
    86→
    87→    return Object.fromEntries(summaryEntries);

    89→
    90→  private writeConsole(
    91→    level: LogLevel,
    92→    message: string,
    93→    context?: LogContext,
    94→  ): void {
    95→    const summary = this.summarizeConsoleContext(context);
    96→    const prefix =
    97→      level === 'WARNING'
    98→        ? `${this.logPrefix} WARN ${message}`
    99→        : level === 'ERROR'
   100→          ? `${this.logPrefix} ERROR ${message}`
   101→          : level === 'CRITICAL'
   102→            ? `${this.logPrefix} CRITICAL ${message}`
   103→            : `${this.logPrefix} ${message}`;
   104→
   105→    if (level === 'DEBUG' || level === 'INFO') {
   106→      if (!this.consoleDebugEnabled()) {
   107→        return;
   108→      }
   109→      if (summary) {
   110→        console.log(prefix, summary);
   111→        return;
   112→      }
   113→      console.log(prefix);
   114→      return;
   115→    }
   116→
   117→    if (level === 'WARNING') {
   118→      if (summary) {
   119→        console.warn(prefix, summary);
   120→        return;
   121→      }
   122→      console.warn(prefix);
   123→      return;
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    if (summary) {
   127→      console.error(prefix, summary);
   128→      return;
   129→    }
   130→    console.error(prefix);
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   134→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
   135→    
   136→    this.logBuffer.push({
   137→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   138→      source_type: 'edge_function',
   139→      source_id: this.functionName,
   140→      log_level: level,
   141→      message,
   142→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
   143→      metadata
   144→    });
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   148→    this.writeConsole('DEBUG', message, context);
   149→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   153→    this.writeConsole('INFO', message, context);
   154→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   158→    this.writeConsole('WARNING', message, context);
   159→    this.addToBuffer('WARNING', message, context);
   160→  }
   161→
   162→  error(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   163→    this.writeConsole('ERROR', message, context);
   164→    this.addToBuffer('ERROR', message, context);
   165→  }
   166→
   167→  critical(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   168→    this.writeConsole('CRITICAL', message, context);
   169→    this.addToBuffer('CRITICAL', message, context);

   172→  /**
   173→   * Flush all buffered logs to the database
   174→   * Call this before returning your response!
   175→   */
   176→  async flush(): Promise<{ inserted: number; errors: number }> {
   177→    if (this.logBuffer.length === 0) {
   178→      return { inserted: 0, errors: 0 };
   179→    }
   180→
   181→    try {
   182→      const { data, error } = await this.supabaseAdmin
   183→        .rpc('func_insert_logs_batch', { logs: this.logBuffer });
   184→
   185→      if (error) {
   186→        console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Failed to flush ${this.logBuffer.length} logs to database:`, error.message);
   187→        // Don't clear buffer on error - logs are lost but at least console has them
   188→        return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   189→      }
   190→
   191→      const result = data || { inserted: this.logBuffer.length, errors: 0 };
   192→      const bufferSize = this.logBuffer.length;
   193→      this.logBuffer = []; // Clear buffer after successful flush
   194→      return { inserted: result.inserted || bufferSize, errors: result.errors || 0 };
   195→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   196→      console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Exception flushing logs:`, e?.message || e);
   197→      return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   198→    }
   199→  }
   200→
   201→  /**
   202→   * Get the current buffer size (useful for debugging)
   203→   */
   204→  getBufferSize(): number {
   205→    return this.logBuffer.length;
   206→  }
   207→}

    72→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
    73→      setStepIndex(0);
    74→      setIsPaused(false);
    75→      resetAllPaneLocks();
    76→    } else if (!isRunning) {
    77→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
    78→    }
    79→  }, [isRunning, resetAllPaneLocks]);
    80→
    81→  return { stepIndex, setStepIndex, isPaused, setIsPaused };

    83→
    84→function useSpotlightClickAdvance(input: {
    85→  isRunning: boolean;
    86→  isPaused: boolean;
    87→  stepIndex: number;
    88→  setStepIndex: (value: number) => void;
    89→  setIsPaused: (value: boolean) => void;
    90→  setIsTasksPaneLocked: (locked: boolean) => void;
    91→  scheduleTimeout: ScheduleTimeout;
    92→}) {
    93→  const {
    94→    isRunning,
    95→    isPaused,
    96→    stepIndex,
    97→    setStepIndex,
    98→    setIsPaused,
    99→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   100→    scheduleTimeout,
   101→  } = input;
   102→
   103→  useEffect(() => {
   104→    if (!isRunning || isPaused) {
   105→      return;
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    const currentStep = tourSteps[stepIndex];
   109→    if (!currentStep?.spotlightClicks) {
   110→      return;
   111→    }
   112→
   113→    const target = document.querySelector(currentStep.target as string);
   114→    if (!target) {
   115→      return;
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    const handleClick = () => {
   119→      const nextIndex = stepIndex + 1;
   120→      const behavior = getSpotlightAdvanceBehavior(stepIndex);
   121→
   122→      if (behavior.lockTasksPane) {
   123→        setIsTasksPaneLocked(true);
   124→      }
   125→
   126→      if (behavior.delayMs) {
   127→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, behavior.delayMs, scheduleTimeout);
   128→        return;
   129→      }
   130→
   131→      setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   132→    };
   133→
   134→    target.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
   135→    return () => target.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
   136→  }, [isPaused, isRunning, scheduleTimeout, setIsPaused, setIsTasksPaneLocked, setStepIndex, stepIndex]);
   137→}
   138→
   139→function useJoyrideCallback(input: {
   140→  completeTour: () => void;
   141→  skipTour: () => void;
   142→  setIsGenerationsPaneLocked: (locked: boolean) => void;
   143→  setIsTasksPaneLocked: (locked: boolean) => void;
   144→  setStepIndex: (value: number) => void;
   145→  setIsPaused: (value: boolean) => void;
   146→  navigate: (path: string) => void;
   147→  scheduleTimeout: ScheduleTimeout;
   148→}) {
   149→  const {
   150→    completeTour,
   151→    skipTour,
   152→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   153→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   154→    setStepIndex,
   155→    setIsPaused,
   156→    navigate,
   157→    scheduleTimeout,
   158→  } = input;
   159→
   160→  return useCallback((data: CallBackProps) => {
   161→    const { status, index, type, action } = data;
   162→
   163→    if (type === EVENTS.STEP_AFTER || type === EVENTS.TARGET_NOT_FOUND) {
   164→      const nextIndex = index + (action === ACTIONS.PREV ? -1 : 1);
   165→      const behavior = getJoyrideAdvanceBehavior(index, action);
   166→
   167→      if (behavior.type === 'advance') {
   168→        setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   169→      } else if (behavior.type === 'pause') {
   170→        if (behavior.dispatchEvent) {
   171→          dispatchTourEvent(behavior.dispatchEvent);
   172→        }
   173→        if (behavior.lockGenerationsPane) {
   174→          setIsGenerationsPaneLocked(true);
   175→        }
   176→        if (behavior.lockTasksPane) {
   177→          setIsTasksPaneLocked(true);
   178→        }
   179→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, behavior.delayMs, scheduleTimeout);
   180→      } else if (behavior.type === 'waitForTarget') {
   181→        if (behavior.dispatchEvent) {
   182→          dispatchTourEvent(behavior.dispatchEvent);
   183→        }
   184→        if (behavior.releaseGenerationsPane) {
   185→          setIsGenerationsPaneLocked(false);
   186→        }
   187→        setIsPaused(true);
   188→        scheduleTimeout(() => {
   189→          const waitForTarget = () => {
   190→            const target = document.querySelector(behavior.selector);
   191→            if (target) {
   192→              setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   193→              scheduleTimeout(() => setIsPaused(false), behavior.resumeDelayMs);
   194→            } else {
   195→              scheduleTimeout(waitForTarget, behavior.resumeDelayMs);
   196→            }
   197→          };
   198→          waitForTarget();
   199→        }, behavior.delayMs);
   200→      } else {
   201→        const target = document.querySelector(behavior.selector) as HTMLElement | null;
   202→        target?.click();
   203→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, behavior.delayMs, scheduleTimeout);
   204→      }
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    if (status === STATUS.FINISHED) {
   208→      completeTour();
   209→      navigate(TOOL_ROUTES.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES);
   210→    } else if (status === STATUS.SKIPPED) {
   211→      skipTour();
   212→    }
   213→  }, [
   214→    completeTour,
   215→    navigate,
   216→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   217→    setIsPaused,
   218→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   219→    setStepIndex,
   220→    scheduleTimeout,
   221→    skipTour,
   222→  ]);
   223→}
   224→
   225→export function ProductTour() {
   226→  const { isRunning, completeTour, skipTour } = useProductTour();
   227→  const { setIsGenerationsPaneLocked, setIsTasksPaneLocked, resetAllPaneLocks } = usePanes();
   228→  const navigate = useNavigate();
   229→  const { scheduleTimeout, clearScheduledTimeouts } = useManagedTimeouts();
   230→  const { stepIndex, setStepIndex, isPaused, setIsPaused } = useTourProgressState(
   231→    isRunning,
   232→    resetAllPaneLocks
   233→  );
   234→
   235→  useEffect(() => {
   236→    if (!isRunning) {
   237→      clearScheduledTimeouts();
   238→    }
   239→  }, [clearScheduledTimeouts, isRunning]);
   240→
   241→  useSpotlightClickAdvance({
   242→    isRunning,
   243→    isPaused,
   244→    stepIndex,
   245→    setStepIndex,
   246→    setIsPaused,
   247→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   248→    scheduleTimeout,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  const handleCallback = useJoyrideCallback({
   252→    completeTour,
   253→    skipTour,
   254→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   255→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   256→    setStepIndex,
   257→    setIsPaused,
   258→    navigate,
   259→    scheduleTimeout,
   260→  });
   261→
   262→  if (!isRunning) {
   263→    return null;
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return (
   267→    <Joyride
   268→      steps={tourSteps}
   269→      run={isRunning && !isPaused}
   270→      stepIndex={stepIndex}
   271→      continuous
   272→      scrollToFirstStep
   273→      showSkipButton
   274→      showProgress
   275→      disableCloseOnEsc={false}
   276→      disableOverlayClose
   277→      callback={handleCallback}
   278→      tooltipComponent={CustomTooltip}
   279→      styles={{

1→/**
     2→ * useReplaceInShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles swapping timeline position from a parent generation to the current image.
     5→ * Used when user wants to replace a parent image in the timeline with a derived image.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→
    12→interface UseReplaceInShotProps {
    13→  /** Callback to close the lightbox after successful replacement */
    14→  onClose: () => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    18→  /**
    19→   * Replace parent's timeline position with current image
    20→   * @param parentGenerationId - ID of the parent generation to remove from timeline
    21→   * @param currentMediaId - ID of the current media to place in timeline
    22→   * @param parentTimelineFrame - Timeline frame position to use
    23→   * @param shotId - Shot ID for the replacement
    24→   */
    25→  handleReplaceInShot: (
    26→    parentGenerationId: string,
    27→    currentMediaId: string,
    28→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    29→    shotId: string
    30→  ) => Promise<ReplaceInShotResult>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→type ReplaceInShotFailureStage =
    34→  | 'clear_parent'
    35→  | 'fetch_target_assoc'
    36→  | 'assign_target'
    37→  | 'restore_parent';
    38→
    39→export type ReplaceInShotResult =
    40→  | { ok: true }
    41→  | {
    42→      ok: false;
    43→      stage: ReplaceInShotFailureStage;
    44→      recovered: boolean;
    45→      message: string;
    46→    };
    47→
    48→export function useReplaceInShot({
    49→  onClose,
    50→}: UseReplaceInShotProps): UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    51→  const handleReplaceInShot = useCallback(async (
    52→    parentGenerationId: string,
    53→    currentMediaId: string,
    54→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    55→    shotIdParam: string
    56→  ): Promise<ReplaceInShotResult> => {
    57→    const restoreParentTimelineFrame = async (): Promise<Error | null> => {
    58→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    59→        .update({ timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame })
    60→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    61→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    62→      return error ?? null;
    63→    };
    64→
    65→    try {
    66→      // 1. Remove timeline_frame from parent's shot_generation record
    67→      const { error: removeError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    68→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
    69→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    70→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    71→
    72→      if (removeError) {
    73→        throw {
    74→          stage: 'clear_parent' as const,
    75→          recovered: false,
    76→          cause: removeError,
    77→        };
    78→      }
    79→
    80→      // 2. Update or create shot_generation for current image with the timeline_frame
    81→      // First check if current image already has a shot_generation for this shot
    82→      const { data: existingAssoc, error: existingAssocError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→        .select('id')
    84→        .eq('generation_id', currentMediaId)
    85→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam)
    86→        .maybeSingle();
    87→
    88→      if (existingAssocError) {
    89→        const restoreError = await restoreParentTimelineFrame();
    90→        throw {
    91→          stage: restoreError ? 'restore_parent' as const : 'fetch_target_assoc' as const,
    92→          recovered: !restoreError,
    93→          cause: existingAssocError,
    94→          restoreError,
    95→        };
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      if (existingAssoc) {
    99→        // Update existing
   100→        const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   101→          .update({
   102→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
   103→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
   104→          })
   105→          .eq('id', existingAssoc.id);
   106→
   107→        if (updateError) {
   108→          const restoreError = await restoreParentTimelineFrame();
   109→          throw {
   110→            stage: restoreError ? 'restore_parent' as const : 'assign_target' as const,
   111→            recovered: !restoreError,
   112→            cause: updateError,
   113→            restoreError,
   114→          };
   115→        }
   116→      } else {
   117→        // Create new
   118→        const { error: createError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   119→          .insert({
   120→            shot_id: shotIdParam,
   121→            generation_id: currentMediaId,
   122→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
   123→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
   124→          });
   125→
   126→        if (createError) {
   127→          const restoreError = await restoreParentTimelineFrame();
   128→          throw {
   129→            stage: restoreError ? 'restore_parent' as const : 'assign_target' as const,
   130→            recovered: !restoreError,
   131→            cause: createError,
   132→            restoreError,
   133→          };
   134→        }
   135→      }
   136→
   137→      // Close lightbox to force refresh when reopened
   138→      onClose();
   139→      return { ok: true };
   140→    } catch (error) {
   141→      const failure = (
   142→        error && typeof error === 'object' && 'stage' in error && 'recovered' in error
   143→      ) ? error as {
   144→        stage: ReplaceInShotFailureStage;
   145→        recovered: boolean;
   146→        cause: unknown;
   147→        restoreError?: unknown;
   148→      } : null;
   149→
   150→      normalizeAndPresentError(failure?.cause ?? error, {
   151→        context: 'useReplaceInShot',
   152→        showToast: false,
   153→        logData: failure
   154→          ? {
   155→              stage: failure.stage,
   156→              recovered: failure.recovered,
   157→              restoreError: failure.restoreError,
   158→            }
   159→          : undefined,
   160→      });
   161→      return {
   162→        ok: false,
   163→        stage: failure?.stage ?? 'assign_target',
   164→        recovered: failure?.recovered ?? false,
   165→        message: failure?.recovered
   166→          ? 'Replace-in-shot failed, but the parent timeline position was restored.'
   167→          : 'Replace-in-shot failed after mutating timeline state.',
   168→      };
   169→    }
   170→  }, [onClose]);
   171→
   172→  return { handleReplaceInShot };
   173→}

1→-- ============================================================================
     2→-- CRITICAL SECURITY FIX: Enable RLS on projects and shots tables
     3→-- ============================================================================
     4→-- These tables were created WITHOUT RLS in the base schema, allowing any
     5→-- authenticated user to read/modify ALL projects and shots from ALL users.
     6→-- This migration enables RLS and creates proper ownership-based policies.
     7→-- ============================================================================
     8→
     9→-- ============================================================================
    10→-- 1. PROJECTS TABLE - Enable RLS and create policies
    11→-- ============================================================================
    12→
    13→-- Enable RLS (will fail gracefully if already enabled)
    14→ALTER TABLE projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    15→
    16→-- Drop any existing policies to avoid conflicts
    17→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can view their own projects" ON projects;
    18→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can insert their own projects" ON projects;
    19→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can update their own projects" ON projects;
    20→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can delete their own projects" ON projects;
    21→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Service role can manage all projects" ON projects;
    22→
    23→-- Policy: Users can only view their own projects
    24→CREATE POLICY "Users can view their own projects" ON projects
    25→  FOR SELECT
    26→  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
    27→
    28→-- Policy: Users can only insert projects for themselves
    29→CREATE POLICY "Users can insert their own projects" ON projects
    30→  FOR INSERT
    31→  WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
    32→
    33→-- Policy: Users can only update their own projects
    34→CREATE POLICY "Users can update their own projects" ON projects
    35→  FOR UPDATE
    36→  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
    37→
    38→-- Policy: Users can only delete their own projects
    39→CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own projects" ON projects
    40→  FOR DELETE
    41→  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

    59→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can insert their own shots" ON shots;
    60→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can update their own shots" ON shots;
    61→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can delete their own shots" ON shots;

    64→-- Policy: Users can view shots that belong to their projects
    65→CREATE POLICY "Users can view their own shots" ON shots
    66→  FOR SELECT
    67→  USING (
    68→    project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
    69→  );
    70→
    71→-- Policy: Users can insert shots into their own projects
    72→CREATE POLICY "Users can insert their own shots" ON shots

    74→  WITH CHECK (

    76→  );

    96→  USING (true)
    97→  WITH CHECK (true);

    99→-- ============================================================================

   101→-- ============================================================================
   102→
   103→-- Drop the broken policy
   104→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can manage their shot generations" ON shot_generations;
   105→
   106→-- Create proper policy that checks ownership through shot -> project -> user
   107→CREATE POLICY "Users can manage their shot generations" ON shot_generations
   108→  FOR ALL
   109→  USING (
   110→    EXISTS (
   111→      SELECT 1 FROM shots s
   112→      JOIN projects p ON s.project_id = p.id

   129→  FOR ALL

   131→  USING (true)
   132→  WITH CHECK (true);

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→let lifecycleHooksRegistered = false;
    45→
    46→function createAbortError(): Error {
    47→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    48→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    49→  }
    50→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    51→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    52→  return error;
    53→}
    54→
    55→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    56→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    57→    throw createAbortError();
    58→  }
    59→}
    60→
    61→function registerLifecycleHooks(): void {
    62→  if (lifecycleHooksRegistered || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    63→    return;
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    67→    flushAll();
    68→  });
    69→  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    70→    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    }
    73→  });
    74→  lifecycleHooksRegistered = true;
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Initialize the queue with the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    79→ * Must be called during app bootstrap before any settings write is enqueued.
    80→ */
    81→export function initializeSettingsWriteQueue(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    82→  writeFunction = fn;
    83→  registerLifecycleHooks();
    84→}
    85→
    86→/** @internal Only for test isolation — do not call in production code. */
    87→export function resetSettingsWriteQueueForTests(): void {
    88→  for (const pending of pendingByTarget.values()) {
    89→    if (pending.timerId) {
    90→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
    91→    }
    92→  }
    93→  pendingByTarget.clear();
    94→  flushQueue.length = 0;
    95→  inFlightCount = 0;
    96→  writeFunction = null;
    97→  lifecycleHooksRegistered = false;
    98→}

   103→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
   104→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
   109→ */
   110→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
   111→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
   112→}
   113→
   114→/**
   115→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
   116→ */
   117→async function processQueue() {
   118→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   119→    return;
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   123→  if (!next) return;
   124→
   125→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   126→  
   127→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   128→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   129→  
   130→  inFlightCount++;
   131→  
   132→  try {
   133→    if (!writeFunction) {
   134→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   135→    }
   136→
   137→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   138→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   139→    
   140→    // Resolve all waiters
   141→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   142→      resolve(result);
   143→    }
   144→  } catch (error) {
   145→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   146→
   147→    // Reject all waiters
   148→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   149→      reject(error);
   150→    }
   151→  } finally {
   152→    inFlightCount--;
   153→    
   154→    // Process next item
   155→    processQueue();
   156→  }
   157→}
   158→
   159→/**
   160→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   161→ */
   162→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   163→  // Clear existing timer
   164→  if (pending.timerId) {
   165→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   166→    pending.timerId = null;
   167→  }
   168→  
   169→  // Add to flush queue and process
   170→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   171→  processQueue();
   172→}
   173→
   174→/**
   175→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   176→ * 
   177→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   178→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   179→ * 
   180→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   181→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   182→ */
   183→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   184→  write: QueuedWrite,
   185→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   186→): Promise<unknown> {
   187→  if (!writeFunction) {
   188→    throw new Error(
   189→      '[SettingsWriteQueue] enqueueSettingsWrite called before initializeSettingsWriteQueue. ' +
   190→      'Ensure app bootstrap initializes the queue before settings writes run.'
   191→    );
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  const key = targetKey(write);
   195→
   196→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   197→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   198→      reject(createAbortError());
   199→      return;
   200→    }
   201→
   202→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   203→
   204→    if (existing) {
   205→      // Merge with existing pending write
   206→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   207→      if (write.signal) {
   208→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   209→      }
   210→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   211→
   212→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   213→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   214→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   215→      }
   216→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   217→      
   218→    } else {
   219→      // Create new pending write
   220→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   221→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   222→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   223→        timerId: null,
   224→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   225→      };
   226→
   227→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   228→
   229→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   230→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   231→      } else {
   232→        // Set debounce timer
   233→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   234→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   235→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   236→      }
   237→    }
   238→  });
   239→}
   240→
   241→
   242→/**
   243→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   244→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   245→ */
   246→function flushAll(): void {
   247→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   248→    if (pending.timerId) {
   249→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   250→      pending.timerId = null;
   251→    }
   252→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   253→  }
   254→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   255→  processQueue();
   256→}
   257→
