```
   264→  hasShotSettings: boolean;
   265→}
   266→/**
   267→ * Get authenticated user ID without acquiring navigator.locks.
   268→ *
   269→ * Resolution order (all synchronous / lock-free):
   270→ *   1. In-memory cache (seeded during runtime bootstrap auth sync)
   271→ *   2. localStorage session (same key Supabase uses; contains full user object)
   272→ *   3. null — user is genuinely signed out
   273→ *
   274→ * Previously this called getSession() / getUser() which both acquire a shared
   275→ * navigator.lock. During token refresh Supabase holds an EXCLUSIVE lock, so
   276→ * ALL shared-lock requests queue behind it — blocking for 600ms-16s. By reading
   277→ * the user ID from localStorage instead we avoid locks entirely. Token validity
   278→ * for actual data requests is handled by createSupabaseClient's cached token.
   279→ */
   280→function buildUserLookupResult(userId: string | null): UserLookupResult {
   281→  return Promise.resolve({
   282→    data: { user: userId ? { id: userId } : null },
   283→    error: null,
   284→  });
   285→}
   286→
   287→function readFreshCachedUserId(): string | null | undefined {
   288→  if (!hasCachedUserSnapshot) {
   289→    return undefined;
   290→  }
   291→  if (cleanupAuthCacheSync) {
   292→    return cachedUser?.id ?? null;
   293→  }
   294→  if ((Date.now() - cachedUserAt) >= USER_CACHE_MS) {
   295→    return undefined;
   296→  }
   297→  return cachedUser?.id ?? null;
   298→}
   299→
   300→export function readCachedUserId(): UserLookupResult {
   301→  const cachedUserId = readFreshCachedUserId();
   302→  return buildUserLookupResult(cachedUserId ?? null);
   303→}
   304→
   305→export function resolveAndCacheUserId(): UserLookupResult {
   306→  const cachedUserId = readFreshCachedUserId();
   307→  if (cachedUserId !== undefined) {
   308→    return buildUserLookupResult(cachedUserId);
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return ensureToolSettingsAuthCacheInitialized().then(() => {
   312→    return buildUserLookupResult(readFreshCachedUserId() ?? null);
   313→  });
   314→}
   315→type SettingsRow = { data: { settings: unknown } | null; error: unknown };
   316→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
   317→  if (!signal?.aborted) {
   318→    return;
   319→  }
   320→  throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   321→    recoverable: true,
   322→  });
   323→}
   324→type AbortableQuery<T> = {
   325→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;
   326→};
   327→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
   328→  if (!signal) {
   329→    return query;
   330→  }
   331→  const abortable = query as AbortableQuery<T>;
   332→  if (typeof abortable.abortSignal === 'function') {
   333→    return abortable.abortSignal(signal);
   334→  }
   335→  return query;
   336→}
   337→async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
   338→  if (!signal) {
   339→    return promise;
   340→  }
   341→  throwIfAborted(signal);
   342→  return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   343→    const onAbort = () => {
   344→      cleanup();
   345→      reject(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   346→        recoverable: true,
   347→      }));
   348→    };
   349→    const cleanup = () => {
   350→      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
   351→    };
   352→    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
   353→    promise.then(
   354→      (value) => {
   355→        cleanup();
   356→        resolve(value);
   357→      },
   358→      (error) => {
   359→        cleanup();
   360→        reject(error);
   361→      },
   362→    );
   363→  });
   364→}
   365→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */
   366→function fetchAllScopes(
   367→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,
   368→  userId: string,
   369→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   370→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   371→): Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]> {
   372→  const userQuery = maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   373→    supabaseClient
   374→      .from('users')
   375→      .select('settings')
   376→      .eq('id', userId)
   377→      .maybeSingle(),
   378→    signal,
   379→  );
   380→  const projectQuery = ctx.projectId
   381→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   382→        supabaseClient
   383→          .from('projects')
   384→          .select('settings')
   385→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   386→          .maybeSingle(),
   387→        signal,
   388→      )
   389→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   390→  const shotQuery = ctx.shotId
   391→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   392→        supabaseClient
   393→          .from('shots')
   394→          .select('settings')
   395→          .eq('id', ctx.shotId)
   396→          .maybeSingle(),
   397→        signal,
   398→      )
   399→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   400→  return Promise.all([
   401→    userQuery,
   402→    projectQuery,
   403→    shotQuery,
   404→  ]) as Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]>;
   405→}
   406→/** Extract tool-specific settings from scope results and merge in priority order. */
   407→function extractAndMergeSettings(
   408→  userResult: SettingsRow,
   409→  projectResult: SettingsRow,
   410→  shotResult: SettingsRow,
   411→  toolId: string,
   412→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   413→): SettingsFetchResult {
   414→  if (userResult.error) {
   415→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   416→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   417→      `Failed to load user settings: ${getErrorMessage(userResult.error)}`,
   418→      { recoverable: true, cause: userResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'user' } },
   419→    );
   420→  }
   421→  if (ctx.projectId && projectResult.error) {
   422→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   423→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   424→      `Failed to load project settings: ${getErrorMessage(projectResult.error)}`,
   425→      { recoverable: true, cause: projectResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'project', projectId: ctx.projectId } },
   426→    );
   427→  }
   428→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   429→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   430→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   431→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${getErrorMessage(shotResult.error)}`,
   432→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   433→    );
   434→  }
   435→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   436→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   437→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   438→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   439→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   440→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   441→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
   442→  const hasShotSettings = shotSettings && Object.keys(shotSettings).length > 0;
   443→  const merged = deepMerge(
   444→    {},
   445→    defaultSettings,
   446→    userSettings,
   447→    projectSettings,
   448→    shotSettings
   449→  );
   450→  return { settings: merged, hasShotSettings };
   451→}
   452→/**
   453→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   454→ *
   455→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   456→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.
   457→ *
   458→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper
   459→ */
   460→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   461→  toolId: string,
   462→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   463→  signal?: AbortSignal
   464→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {
   465→  try {
   466→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);
   467→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   468→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   469→        recoverable: true,
   470→      }));
   471→    }
   472→    const { data: { user } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   473→    if (!user) {
   474→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required'));
   475→    }
   476→    const userId = user.id;
   477→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({
   478→      toolId,
   479→      projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null,
   480→      shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null,
   481→      userId,
   482→    });
   483→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   484→    if (existingPromise) {
   485→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   486→      return operationSuccess(value);
   487→    }
   488→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   489→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   490→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   491→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, userId, ctx, signal);
   492→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   493→      const { data: { user: latestUser } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   494→      if (!latestUser || latestUser.id !== userId) {
   495→        throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled due to auth state change', {
   496→          recoverable: true,
   497→          metadata: { expectedUserId: userId, latestUserId: latestUser?.id ?? null },
   498→        });
   499→      }
   500→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   501→    })();
   502→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   503→    promise.finally(() => {
   504→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   505→    }).catch(() => {});
   506→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   507→    return operationSuccess(value);
   508→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   509→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   510→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   511→    }
   512→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   513→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   514→        recoverable: true,
   515→        cause: error,
   516→      }));
   517→    }
   518→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   519→    const contextInfo = {
   520→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   521→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   522→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   523→    };
   524→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   525→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   526→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   527→        showToast: false,
   528→        logData: contextInfo,
   529→      });
   530→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   531→        'network',
   532→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   533→        {
   534→          recoverable: true,
   535→          cause: error,
   536→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   537→        },
   538→      ));
   539→    }
   540→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   541→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   542→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   543→        'network',
   544→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   545→        {
   546→          recoverable: true,
   547→          cause: error,
   548→          metadata: contextInfo,
   549→        },
   550→      ));
   551→    }
   552→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   553→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   554→  }
   555→}
   556→/**
   557→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   558→ *
   559→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   560→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   561→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   562→ */
   563→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   564→  toolId: string,
   565→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   566→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   567→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   568→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   569→  if (!result.ok) {
   570→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   571→  }
   572→  return result.value;
   573→}
   574→
```

```
   244→function resolveMainGeneration(input: {

   342→function isButtonDisabled(args: UseLoraSubmissionArgs): boolean {
   343→  const { isSubmitting, isUploading, addForm, uploadMode, isEditMode, hasHfToken, isMultiStageModel, loraFiles } = args;
   344→  if (isSubmitting || isUploading) {
   345→    return true;
   346→  }
   347→
   348→  if (uploadMode === 'file' && !isEditMode && !hasHfToken) {
   349→    return true;
   350→  }

   353→  return getValidationError(addForm, loraFiles, mode) !== null;

   356→export function useLoraSubmission(args: UseLoraSubmissionArgs) {
   357→  const handleAddLoraFromForm = async () => {
   358→    const mode = getSubmissionMode(args.uploadMode, args.isMultiStageModel, args.isEditMode);
   359→    const validationError = getValidationError(args.addForm, args.loraFiles, mode);
   360→    if (validationError) {
   361→      toast.error(validationError);
   362→      return;
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    args.setIsSubmitting(true);
   366→
   367→    try {
   368→      const initialUrls: SubmissionUrls = {
   369→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: args.addForm.huggingface_url,
   370→        finalHighNoiseUrl: args.addForm.high_noise_url,
   371→        finalLowNoiseUrl: args.addForm.low_noise_url,
   372→      };
   373→
   374→      const resolvedUrls = await uploadToHuggingFaceIfNeeded(mode, {
   375→        addForm: args.addForm,
   376→        userName: args.userName,
   377→        loraFiles: args.loraFiles,
   378→        sampleFiles: args.sampleFiles,
   379→        uploadToHuggingFace: args.uploadToHuggingFace,
   380→        urls: initialUrls,
   381→      });
   382→
   383→      const uploadedSamples = await uploadSampleFiles(args.sampleFiles);
   384→      const { finalSamples, finalImages } = buildFinalSamplesAndImages({
   385→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   386→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   387→        deletedExistingSampleUrls: args.deletedExistingSampleUrls,
   388→        uploadedSamples,
   389→      });
   390→
   391→      const mainGeneration = resolveMainGeneration({
   392→        uploadedSamples,
   393→        mainGenerationIndex: args.mainGenerationIndex,
   394→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   395→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   396→        deletedExistingSampleUrls: args.deletedExistingSampleUrls,
   397→        finalSamples,
   398→      });
   399→
   400→      const uniqueFilename = resolveUniqueFilename({
   401→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   402→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   403→        addForm: args.addForm,
   404→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHuggingfaceUrl,
   405→        existingFilenames: args.getExistingFilenames(),
   406→      });
   407→
   408→      const loraMetadata = buildLoraMetadata({
   409→        addForm: args.addForm,
   410→        userName: args.userName,
   411→        uniqueFilename,
   412→        isMultiStageModel: args.isMultiStageModel,
   413→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHuggingfaceUrl,
   414→        finalHighNoiseUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHighNoiseUrl,
   415→        finalLowNoiseUrl: resolvedUrls.finalLowNoiseUrl,
   416→        finalSamples,
   417→        finalImages,
   418→        mainGeneration,
   419→      });
   420→
   421→      if (args.isEditMode && args.editingLora) {
   422→        await args.updateResource.mutateAsync({
   423→          id: args.editingLora.id,
   424→          type: 'lora',
   425→          metadata: loraMetadata,
   426→        });
   427→        args.onClearEdit();
   428→      } else {
   429→        await args.createResource.mutateAsync({
   430→          type: 'lora',
   431→          metadata: loraMetadata,
   432→        });
   433→      }
   434→
   435→      args.resetForm();
   436→      args.onSwitchToBrowse();
   437→    } catch (error) {
   438→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   439→        context: 'MyLorasTab',
   440→        toastTitle: `Failed to ${args.isEditMode ? 'update' : 'add'} LoRA`,
   441→      });
   442→    } finally {
   443→      args.setIsSubmitting(false);
   444→    }
   445→  };
   446→
   447→  return {
   448→    handleAddLoraFromForm,
   449→    isButtonDisabled: () => isButtonDisabled(args),
   450→  };
   451→}
```

```
1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
    30→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Centralized task configuration system
     3→ * 
     4→ * This module provides synchronous access to task type configuration.
     5→ * Configuration is loaded from the database (task_types table) and cached globally.
     6→ * Hardcoded fallbacks exist for backwards compatibility and offline scenarios.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { getTaskTypeConfigCache, isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized, type TaskTypeInfo } from '@/shared/lib/taskTypeCache';
    10→import {
    11→  getTaskTypeConfigFallback,
    12→  getTaskTypeFallbackEntries,
    13→} from '@/shared/lib/taskTypeConfigFallback';
    14→
    15→interface TaskTypeConfig {
    16→  /** Whether this task type should be visible in the UI */
    17→  isVisible: boolean;
    18→  /** Display name for the task type (overrides the raw taskType) */
    19→  displayName?: string;
    20→  /** Whether this task type supports progress checking */
    21→  supportsProgress?: boolean;
    22→  /** Whether this task type can be manually cancelled by users */
    23→  canCancel?: boolean;
    24→  /** Category for grouping related task types */
    25→  category?: 'generation' | 'processing' | 'orchestration' | 'utility';
    26→  /** Description for documentation/debugging */
    27→  description?: string;
    28→}
    29→
    30→function dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig: TaskTypeInfo): TaskTypeConfig {
    31→  return {
    32→    isVisible: dbConfig.is_visible ?? false,
    33→    displayName: dbConfig.display_name,
    34→    supportsProgress: dbConfig.supports_progress ?? false,
    35→    canCancel: true, // Default all tasks to cancellable
    36→    category: dbConfig.category as TaskTypeConfig['category'],
    37→  };
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Get configuration for a specific task type
    42→ * Checks the database cache first, falls back to hardcoded defaults
    43→ */
    44→function getTaskConfig(taskType: string): TaskTypeConfig {
    45→  // Check database cache first (populated by useAllTaskTypesConfig hook)
    46→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    47→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
    48→    const dbConfig = cache[taskType];
    49→    if (dbConfig) {
    50→      return dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig);
    51→    }
    52→  }
    53→  
    54→  // Fall back to the shared fallback snapshot.
    55→  const fallbackConfig = getTaskTypeConfigFallback(taskType);
    56→  if (fallbackConfig) {
    57→    return fallbackConfig;
    58→  }
    59→  
    60→  // Default for completely unknown task types
    61→  return {
    62→    isVisible: false, // Default to hidden for unknown types
    63→    canCancel: true,
    64→    category: 'utility'
    65→  };
    66→}
    67→
    68→function isTaskVisible(taskType: string): boolean {
    69→  return getTaskConfig(taskType).isVisible;
    70→}
    71→
    72→export function getTaskDisplayName(taskType: string): string {
    73→  const config = getTaskConfig(taskType);
    74→  return config.displayName || taskType;
    75→}
    76→
    77→export function taskSupportsProgress(taskType: string): boolean {
    78→  return getTaskConfig(taskType).supportsProgress || false;
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Get task types filtered by visibility
    83→ * Uses database cache if available, falls back to hardcoded list
    84→ */
    85→function getTaskTypesByVisibility(visible: boolean): string[] {
    86→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    87→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
    88→    return Object.entries(cache)
    89→      .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.is_visible : !config.is_visible)
    90→      .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  // Fall back to the versioned fallback snapshot.
    94→  return getTaskTypeFallbackEntries()
    95→    .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.isVisible : !config.isVisible)
    96→    .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
    97→}
    98→
    99→export function getVisibleTaskTypes(): string[] {
   100→  return getTaskTypesByVisibility(true);
   101→}
   102→
   103→export function getHiddenTaskTypes(): string[] {
   104→  return getTaskTypesByVisibility(false);
   105→}
   106→
   107→export function filterVisibleTasks<T extends { taskType: string }>(tasks: T[]): T[] {
   108→  return tasks.filter(task => isTaskVisible(task.taskType));
   109→}
```

```
     2→ * Runtime project selection snapshot for non-React consumers.
     3→ *
     4→ * This replaces ad-hoc window globals with an explicit typed access layer.
     5→ */
     6→const [REDACTED];

     8→interface ProjectSelectionSnapshot {
     9→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    10→}
    11→
    12→type ProjectSelectionListener = (snapshot: ProjectSelectionSnapshot) => void;
    13→
    14→function readPersistedProjectSelection(): string | null {
    15→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    16→    return null;
    17→  }
    18→
    19→  try {
    20→    const persisted = window.localStorage.getItem(PROJECT_SELECTION_STORAGE_KEY);
    21→    return persisted && persisted.trim().length > 0 ? persisted : null;
    22→  } catch {
    23→    return null;
    24→  }
    25→}
    26→
    27→function normalizeSelectedProjectId(selectedProjectId: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    28→  return selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0 ? selectedProjectId : null;
    29→}
    30→
    31→let snapshot: ProjectSelectionSnapshot = { selectedProjectId: null };
    32→let initialized = false;
    33→const listeners = new Set<ProjectSelectionListener>();
    34→
    35→export function initializeProjectSelectionStore(
    36→  initialSelectedProjectId: string | null = readPersistedProjectSelection(),
    37→): ProjectSelectionSnapshot {
    38→  const normalized: ProjectSelectionSnapshot = {
    39→    selectedProjectId: normalizeSelectedProjectId(initialSelectedProjectId),
    40→  };
    41→  const shouldNotify = initialized && snapshot.selectedProjectId !== normalized.selectedProjectId;
    42→  snapshot = normalized;
    43→  initialized = true;
    44→
    45→  if (shouldNotify) {
    46→    for (const listener of listeners) {
    47→      listener(normalized);
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return getProjectSelectionSnapshot();
    52→}
    53→
    54→export function setProjectSelectionSnapshot(next: ProjectSelectionSnapshot): void {
    55→  initializeProjectSelectionStore(next.selectedProjectId ?? null);
    56→}
    57→
    58→export function getProjectSelectionSnapshot(): ProjectSelectionSnapshot {
    59→  return { ...snapshot };
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function getProjectSelectionFallbackId(): string | null {
    63→  return snapshot.selectedProjectId;
    64→}
    65→
    66→/** @internal Only for test isolation — do not call in production code. */
    67→export function resetProjectSelectionStoreForTests(): void {
    68→  snapshot = { selectedProjectId: null };
    69→  initialized = false;
    70→  listeners.clear();
    71→}
```

```
     3→ *

    24→interface UseStructureVideoHandlersReturn {
    25→  handleUni3cEndPercentChange: (value: number) => void;
    26→  handleStructureVideoMotionStrengthChange: (strength: number) => void;
    27→  handleStructureTypeChangeFromMotionControl: (type: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth') => void;
    28→  handleStructureVideoInputChange: (
    29→    videoPath: string | null,
    30→    metadata: VideoMetadata | null,
    31→    treatment: 'adjust' | 'clip',
    32→    motionStrength: number,
    33→    structureType: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth',
    34→    resourceId?: string
    35→  ) => void;
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useStructureVideoHandlers({
    39→  structureVideos,
    40→  setStructureVideos,
    41→  updateStructureGuidanceControls,
    42→  structureVideoPath,
    43→  structureVideoType,
    44→  structureVideoUni3cEndPercent,
    45→  generationTypeMode,
    46→  setGenerationTypeMode,
    47→}: UseStructureVideoHandlersOptions): UseStructureVideoHandlersReturn {
    48→  const switchModeForStructureType = useCallback((type: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth') => {
    49→    const targetMode = type === 'uni3c' ? 'i2v' : 'vace';
    50→    if (generationTypeMode !== targetMode) {
    51→      setGenerationTypeMode(targetMode);
    52→    }
    53→  }, [generationTypeMode, setGenerationTypeMode]);
    54→
    55→  const handleUni3cEndPercentChange = useCallback((value: number) => {
    56→    if (structureVideos.length === 0) return;
    57→    updateStructureGuidanceControls({ uni3cEndPercent: value });
    58→  }, [structureVideos.length, updateStructureGuidanceControls]);
    59→
    60→  const handleStructureVideoMotionStrengthChange = useCallback((strength: number) => {
    61→    if (structureVideos.length === 0) return;
    62→    updateStructureGuidanceControls({ motionStrength: strength });
    63→  }, [structureVideos.length, updateStructureGuidanceControls]);
    64→
    65→  const handleStructureTypeChangeFromMotionControl = useCallback((type: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth') => {
    66→    if (structureVideos.length > 0) {
    67→      updateStructureGuidanceControls({ structureType: type });
    68→    }
    69→    switchModeForStructureType(type);
    70→  }, [structureVideos.length, switchModeForStructureType, updateStructureGuidanceControls]);
    71→
    72→  const handleStructureVideoInputChange = useCallback((
    73→    videoPath: string | null,
    74→    metadata: VideoMetadata | null,
    75→    treatment: 'adjust' | 'clip',
    76→    motionStrength: number,
    77→    structureType: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth',
    78→    resourceId?: string
    79→  ) => {
    80→    if (!videoPath) {
    81→      setStructureVideos([]);
    82→      if (generationTypeMode !== 'i2v') {
    83→        setGenerationTypeMode('i2v');
    84→      }
    85→      return;
    86→    }
    87→
    88→    const existing = structureVideos[0];
    89→    const nextPrimary: StructureVideoConfigWithMetadata = {
    90→      path: videoPath,
    91→      start_frame: existing?.start_frame ?? 0,
    92→      end_frame: existing?.end_frame ?? 81,
    93→      treatment,
    94→      metadata: metadata ?? null,
    95→      resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
    96→    };
    97→
    98→    if (structureVideos.length > 0) {
    99→      setStructureVideos([nextPrimary, ...structureVideos.slice(1)]);
   100→    } else {
   101→      setStructureVideos([nextPrimary]);
   102→    }
   103→
   104→    updateStructureGuidanceControls({
   105→      motionStrength,
   106→      structureType,
   107→      ...(structureType === 'uni3c' ? { uni3cEndPercent: structureVideoUni3cEndPercent } : {}),
   108→    });
   109→    switchModeForStructureType(structureType);
   110→  }, [
   111→    generationTypeMode,
   112→    setGenerationTypeMode,
   113→    setStructureVideos,
   114→    structureVideos,
   115→    structureVideoUni3cEndPercent,
   116→    switchModeForStructureType,
   117→    updateStructureGuidanceControls,
   118→  ]);
   119→
   120→  const prevStructureVideoPath = useRef<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
   121→  useEffect(() => {
   122→    if (prevStructureVideoPath.current === undefined) {
   123→      prevStructureVideoPath.current = structureVideoPath;
   124→      return;
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    const wasAdded = !prevStructureVideoPath.current && structureVideoPath;
   128→    const wasRemoved = prevStructureVideoPath.current && !structureVideoPath;
   129→
   130→    if (wasAdded) {
   131→      switchModeForStructureType(structureVideoType);
   132→    } else if (wasRemoved && generationTypeMode !== 'i2v') {
   133→      setGenerationTypeMode('i2v');
   134→    }
   135→
   136→    prevStructureVideoPath.current = structureVideoPath;
   137→  }, [
   138→    generationTypeMode,
   139→    setGenerationTypeMode,
   140→    structureVideoPath,
   141→    structureVideoType,
   142→    switchModeForStructureType,
   143→  ]);
   144→
   145→  return {
   146→    handleUni3cEndPercentChange,
   147→    handleStructureVideoMotionStrengthChange,
   148→    handleStructureTypeChangeFromMotionControl,
   149→    handleStructureVideoInputChange,
   150→  };
   151→}
   152→
```

```
    11→
    12→export const applyLoRAs = (
    13→  settings: ExtractedLoraSettings & { advancedMode?: boolean },
    14→  context: ApplyLoraContext,
    15→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
    16→  const loras = settings.loras;
    17→
    18→  // Only apply if NOT in advanced mode
    19→  if (loras === undefined || settings.advancedMode) {
    20→    return Promise.resolve({ success: true, settingName: 'loras', details: 'skipped' });
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  if (loras.length > 0) {
    24→    // Clear existing LoRAs first
    25→    if (context.loraManager.setSelectedLoras) {
    26→      context.loraManager.setSelectedLoras([]);
    27→    }
    28→
    29→    // Map paths to available LoRAs and restore them (with delay to ensure state is cleared)
    30→    return new Promise((resolve) => {
    31→      setTimeout(() => {
    32→        let matchedCount = 0;
    33→
    34→        loras.forEach((loraData) => {
    35→          const matchingLora = context.availableLoras.find(lora => {
    36→            const legacyDownloadLink = (lora as Record<string, unknown>)['Download Link'];
    37→            const loraUrl = lora.huggingface_url ?? (typeof legacyDownloadLink === 'string' ? legacyDownloadLink : '');
    38→            return loraUrl === loraData.path ||
    39→              loraUrl.endsWith(loraData.path) ||
    40→              loraData.path.endsWith(loraUrl.split('/').pop() || '');
    41→          });
    42→
    43→          if (matchingLora) {
    44→            context.loraManager.handleAddLora(matchingLora, false, loraData.strength);
    45→            matchedCount++;
    46→          }
    47→        });
    48→
    49→        resolve({ success: true, settingName: 'loras', details: `${matchedCount}/${loras.length} matched` });
    50→      }, 100); // Small delay to ensure state clears
    51→    });
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  if (context.loraManager.setSelectedLoras) {
    55→    context.loraManager.setSelectedLoras([]);
    56→  }
    57→  return Promise.resolve({ success: true, settingName: 'loras', details: 'cleared' });
    58→};

    61→  settings: ExtractedStructureVideoSettings,

    63→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
    64→  if (!settings.presentInTask) {
    65→    return { success: true, settingName: 'structureVideo', details: 'skipped - not in task' };
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  const primaryStructureVideo = resolvePrimaryStructureVideo(

    71→  );
    72→  const structureVideoPath = primaryStructureVideo.path;
    73→
    74→  if (!structureVideoPath) {

    76→      context.onStructureVideoInputChange(null, null, 'adjust', 1.0, 'uni3c');
    77→    }
    78→    return { success: true, settingName: 'structureVideo', details: 'cleared' };
    79→  }
    80→
    81→  if (!context.onStructureVideoInputChange) {
    82→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('onStructureVideoInputChange is not defined'), {
    83→      context: 'ApplySettings.applyStructureVideo',
    84→      showToast: false,
    85→    });
    86→    return { success: false, settingName: 'structureVideo', error: 'handler not defined' };
    87→  }
    88→
    89→  try {
    90→    let metadata = null;

    93→    } catch {
    94→      // Metadata extraction is optional for restore flow.

    96→

   104→
```

```
    10→export interface MaskedEditTaskParams {
    11→  project_id: string;
    12→  image_url: string;
    13→  mask_url: string;
    14→  prompt: string;
    15→  num_generations: number;
    16→  generation_id?: string;
    17→  shot_id?: string;
    18→  tool_type?: string;
    19→  loras?: ComfyLoraConfig[];
    20→  create_as_generation?: boolean;
    21→  source_variant_id?: string;
    22→  hires_fix?: HiresFixApiParams;
    23→  qwen_edit_model?: string;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig {
    27→  taskType: 'image_inpaint' | 'annotated_image_edit';
    28→  context: string;
    29→  batchOperationName: string;
    30→}
    31→
    32→async function createSingleMaskedEditTask(
    33→  config: MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig,
    34→  params: Omit<MaskedEditTaskParams, 'num_generations'>,
    35→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    36→  const {
    37→    image_url,
    38→    mask_url,
    39→    prompt,
    40→    generation_id,
    41→    shot_id,
    42→    tool_type,
    43→    loras,
    44→    create_as_generation,
    45→    source_variant_id,
    46→    hires_fix,
    47→    qwen_edit_model,
    48→  } = params;
    49→
    50→  const taskParams = composeTaskParams({
    51→    source: params,
    52→    baseParams: {
    53→      image_url,
    54→      mask_url,
    55→      prompt,
    56→      num_generations: 1,
    57→      generation_id,
    58→      based_on: generation_id,
    59→      parent_generation_id: generation_id,
    60→    },
    61→    segments: [
    62→      shot_id ? { shot_id } : undefined,
    63→      tool_type ? { tool_type } : undefined,
    64→      loras && loras.length > 0 ? { loras } : undefined,
    65→      create_as_generation ? { create_as_generation: true } : undefined,
    66→      source_variant_id ? { source_variant_id } : undefined,
    67→      buildHiresFixParams(hires_fix),
    68→      qwen_edit_model ? { qwen_edit_model } : undefined,
    69→    ],
    70→  });
    71→
    72→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
    73→    params,
    74→    context: config.context,
    75→    buildTaskRequest: (pipelineParams) => composeTaskRequest({
    76→      source: pipelineParams,
    77→      taskType: config.taskType,
    78→      params: taskParams,
    79→    }),
    80→  });
    81→}
    82→
    83→export async function createMaskedEditTask(
    84→  config: MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig,
    85→  params: MaskedEditTaskParams,
    86→): Promise<string> {
    87→  const { num_generations, ...singleTaskParams } = params;
    88→
    89→  if (num_generations === 1) {
    90→    const result = await createSingleMaskedEditTask(config, singleTaskParams);
    91→    return result.task_id;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    95→    Array.from({ length: num_generations }, () => createSingleMaskedEditTask(config, singleTaskParams)),
    96→  );
    97→
    98→  const successful = processBatchResults(results, config.batchOperationName);
    99→  return successful[0].task_id;
   100→}
   101→
```

```
   113→async function fetchTaskData(taskId: string) {
   114→  return ApplySettingsService.fetchTask(taskId);
   115→}
   116→
   117→async function applySettingsFromTask(
   118→  taskId: string,
   119→  replaceImages: boolean,
   120→  inputImages: string[],
   121→  handlerState: ApplySettingsHandlerInput,
   122→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   123→) {
   124→  const taskData = await fetchTaskData(taskId);
   125→  if (!taskData) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Task not found'), {
   127→      context: 'useApplySettingsHandler',
   128→      toastTitle: 'Failed to apply settings from task',
   129→      showToast: false,
   130→      logData: { taskId },
   131→    });
   132→    return;
   133→  }
   134→
   135→  const settings = ApplySettingsService.extractSettings(taskData);
   136→  const applyContexts = buildApplyContexts(handlerState);
   137→
   138→  await ApplySettingsService.replaceImagesIfRequested(
   139→    settings.generation,
   140→    settings.images,
   141→    replaceImages,
   142→    inputImages,
   143→    handlerState.core.selectedShot ?? null,
   144→    handlerState.core.projectId,
   145→    handlerState.core.simpleFilteredImages,
   146→    handlerState.mutations.addImageToShotMutation,
   147→    handlerState.mutations.removeImageFromShotMutation,
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  await ApplySettingsService.applyModelSettings(settings.generation, applyContexts.model);
   151→  await ApplySettingsService.applyPromptSettings(settings.prompts, applyContexts.prompts);
   152→  await ApplySettingsService.applyGenerationSettings(settings.generation, applyContexts.generation);
   153→  await ApplySettingsService.applyModeSettings(settings.modes, applyContexts.modes);
   154→  await ApplySettingsService.applyAdvancedModeSettings(settings.advanced, applyContexts.advanced);
   155→  await ApplySettingsService.applyTextPromptAddons(settings.textAddons, applyContexts.textAddons);
   156→  await ApplySettingsService.applyMotionSettings(
   157→    { ...settings.motion, advancedMode: settings.modes.advancedMode },
   158→    applyContexts.motion,
   159→  );
   160→  await ApplySettingsService.applyLoRAs(
   161→    { ...settings.loras, advancedMode: settings.modes.advancedMode },
   162→    applyContexts.loras,
   163→  );
   164→  await ApplySettingsService.applyStructureVideo(settings.structure, applyContexts.structureVideo);
   165→
   166→  if (handlerState.core.selectedShot?.id) {
   167→    enqueueGenerationsInvalidation(queryClient, handlerState.core.selectedShot.id, {
   168→      reason: 'apply-settings-force-reload',
   169→      scope: 'all',
   170→      delayMs: 200,
   171→    });
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
   175→  await Promise.resolve(handlerState.mutations.loadPositions({ silent: true }));
   176→}
   177→
   178→export function useApplySettingsHandler(handlerState: ApplySettingsHandlerInput) {
   179→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   180→  const handlerStateRef = useRef(handlerState);
   181→
   182→  useEffect(() => {
   183→    handlerStateRef.current = handlerState;
   184→  }, [handlerState]);
   185→
   186→  return useCallback(async (taskId: string, replaceImages: boolean, inputImages: string[]) => {
   187→    const latestHandlerState = handlerStateRef.current;
   188→    const hasMissingIds = latestHandlerState.core.simpleFilteredImages.some((img) => !img.id);
   189→    if (hasMissingIds && replaceImages) {
   190→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Loading shot data... please try again in a moment.'), {
   191→        context: 'useApplySettingsHandler',
   192→        toastTitle: 'Loading shot data',
   193→        showToast: true,
   194→      });
   195→      return;
   196→    }
   197→
   198→    try {
   199→      await applySettingsFromTask(taskId, replaceImages, inputImages, latestHandlerState, queryClient);
   200→    } catch (error) {
   201→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   202→        context: 'useApplySettingsHandler',
   203→        toastTitle: 'Failed to apply settings from task',
   204→      });
   205→    }
   206→  }, [queryClient]);
   207→}
```

```
    23→
    24→    if (error || !data) {
    25→      normalizeAndPresentError(error ?? new Error('No task data returned'), {
    26→        context: 'ApplySettings.fetchTask',
    27→        showToast: false,
    28→        logData: { taskId },
    29→      });
    30→      return null;
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    const params = (data.params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    34→    const orchestrator = (params.orchestrator_details || params.full_orchestrator_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    35→
    36→    return { params, orchestrator };
    37→  } catch (queryError) {
    38→    normalizeAndPresentError(queryError, {
    39→      context: 'ApplySettings.fetchTask',
    40→      showToast: false,
    41→      logData: { taskId },
    42→    });
    43→    return null;
    44→  }
    45→};

    47→function extractStructureSettings(taskData: TaskData): ExtractedStructureVideoSettings {
    48→  const params = taskData.params as Record<string, unknown>;
    49→  const orchestrator = taskData.orchestrator as Record<string, unknown>;
    50→  const structureSource = {
    51→    structure_guidance: orchestrator.structure_guidance ?? params.structure_guidance,
    52→    structure_videos: (
    53→      orchestrator.structure_videos ??
    54→      params.structure_videos ??
    55→      ((orchestrator.structure_guidance ?? params.structure_guidance) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.videos
    56→    ),
    57→    structure_video_path: orchestrator.structure_video_path ?? params.structure_video_path,
    58→    structure_video_treatment: orchestrator.structure_video_treatment ?? params.structure_video_treatment,
    59→    structure_video_type: orchestrator.structure_video_type
    60→      ?? orchestrator.structure_type
    61→      ?? params.structure_video_type
    62→      ?? params.structure_type,
    63→    structure_video_motion_strength: orchestrator.structure_video_motion_strength ?? params.structure_video_motion_strength,
    64→    structure_canny_intensity: orchestrator.structure_canny_intensity ?? params.structure_canny_intensity,
    65→    structure_depth_contrast: orchestrator.structure_depth_contrast ?? params.structure_depth_contrast,
    66→    uni3c_start_percent: orchestrator.uni3c_start_percent ?? params.uni3c_start_percent,
    67→    uni3c_end_percent: orchestrator.uni3c_end_percent ?? params.uni3c_end_percent,
    68→    use_uni3c: orchestrator.use_uni3c ?? params.use_uni3c,
    69→  };
    70→  const legacyUsage = collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(structureSource);
    71→  const presentInTask =
    72→    Boolean(structureSource.structure_guidance)
    73→    || Array.isArray(structureSource.structure_videos)
    74→    || structureSource.structure_video_path !== undefined
    75→    || structureSource.structure_video_treatment !== undefined
    76→    || structureSource.structure_video_type !== undefined
    77→    || structureSource.structure_video_motion_strength !== undefined
    78→    || structureSource.structure_canny_intensity !== undefined
    79→    || structureSource.structure_depth_contrast !== undefined
    80→    || structureSource.uni3c_start_percent !== undefined
    81→    || structureSource.uni3c_end_percent !== undefined
    82→    || structureSource.use_uni3c !== undefined
    83→    || legacyUsage.topLevelFields.length > 0
    84→    || legacyUsage.structureVideoFields.length > 0;
    85→
    86→  enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
    87→    legacyUsage,
    88→    {
    89→      context: 'applySettings.extractSettings',
    90→      enforcement: 'warn',
    91→    },
    92→  );
    93→
    94→  const resolvedStructure = resolveTravelStructureState(structureSource, {
    95→    defaultEndFrame: 0,
    96→    defaultVideoTreatment: DEFAULT_STRUCTURE_VIDEO.treatment,
    97→    defaultMotionStrength: DEFAULT_STRUCTURE_VIDEO.motion_strength,
    98→    defaultStructureType: DEFAULT_STRUCTURE_VIDEO.structure_type,
    99→    defaultUni3cEndPercent: DEFAULT_STRUCTURE_VIDEO.uni3c_end_percent,
   100→  });
   101→
   102→  return {
   103→    presentInTask,
   104→    ...(resolvedStructure.structureGuidance ? { structureGuidance: resolvedStructure.structureGuidance } : {}),
   105→    ...(resolvedStructure.structureVideos.length > 0 ? { structureVideos: resolvedStructure.structureVideos } : {}),
   106→  };
   107→}

   109→export const extractSettings = (taskData: TaskData): ExtractedSettings => {

   126→      negativePrompts: orchestrator.negative_prompts_expanded as string[] | undefined,

   169→      turboMode: (orchestrator.turbo_mode ?? params.turbo_mode) as boolean | undefined,
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ *

    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.

    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';

    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shots/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/tasks/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';

    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',

   123→  }
   124→}

   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {

   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→

   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,

   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(

   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,

   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;

   249→function timelineFrameToPositionBucket(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);

   254→/**

   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query

   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;

   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison

   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);

   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,

   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip

   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,

   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: timelineFrameToPositionBucket(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: timelineFrameToPositionBucket(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→
```

```
1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { useToolSettings, type SettingsScope } from '@/shared/hooks/settings/useToolSettings';
     5→
     6→const getSupabase = () => getSupabaseClient();
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Shared hook for edit tool media persistence.
    10→ * Handles loading last-edited media from project settings on mount,
    11→ * preloading the media URL, and saving selection changes back to settings.
    12→ *
    13→ * Used by EditImagesPage and EditVideoPage.
    14→ */
    15→
    16→interface UseEditToolMediaPersistenceParams {
    17→  /** The tool settings key, e.g. 'edit-images-ui' */
    18→  settingsToolId: string;
    19→  /** Current project ID */
    20→  projectId: string | undefined;
    21→  /** Called after a generation is fetched from DB, before setting it as selected.
    22→   *  Use this to preload images/posters. */
    23→  preloadMedia?: (generation: GenerationRow) => void;
    24→  /** Called after successfully loading persisted generation from DB.
    25→   *  Use this to restore extra state like video segments.
    26→   *  Receives the full settings object. */
    27→  onSettingsLoaded?: (settings: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    28→  /** Extra data to merge when clearing settings on editor close.
    29→   *  e.g. { lastEditedMediaSegments: null } for video.
    30→   *  Use null, not undefined — deepMerge skips undefined values. */
    31→  extraClearData?: Record<string, unknown>;
    32→}
    33→
    34→interface UseEditToolMediaPersistenceReturn {
    35→  /** The selected media from persisted settings, or null */
    36→  selectedMedia: GenerationRow | null;
    37→  /** Set the selected media (also persists to settings) */
    38→  setSelectedMedia: (media: GenerationRow | null) => void;
    39→  /** Call this when user explicitly closes the editor */
    40→  handleEditorClose: () => void;
    41→  /** Whether settings are loading or persisted media is being fetched */
    42→  isLoading: boolean;
    43→  /** Whether we have a stored ID that hasn't resolved yet (for skeleton display) */
    44→  showSkeleton: boolean;
    45→  /** The raw UI settings object */
    46→  uiSettings: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    47→  /** The update function from useToolSettings */
    48→  updateUISettings: (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>;
    49→  /** Whether the underlying tool settings are loading */
    50→  isUISettingsLoading: boolean;
    51→  /** Ref tracking whether user explicitly closed the editor */
    52→  userClosedEditor: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
    53→}
    54→
    55→export function useEditToolMediaPersistence({
    56→  settingsToolId,
    57→  projectId,
    58→  preloadMedia,
    59→  onSettingsLoaded,
    60→  extraClearData,
    61→}: UseEditToolMediaPersistenceParams): UseEditToolMediaPersistenceReturn {
    62→  const [selectedMedia, setSelectedMediaState] = useState<GenerationRow | null>(null);
    63→  const [isLoadingPersistedMedia, setIsLoadingPersistedMedia] = useState(false);
    64→
    65→  // Track if we've already loaded from settings to prevent re-loading
    66→  const hasLoadedFromSettings = useRef(false);
    67→  // Track if user has explicitly closed the editor (vs initial mount state)
    68→  const userClosedEditor = useRef(false);
    69→
    70→  // Project-level UI settings for persisting last edited media
    71→  const {
    72→    settings: uiSettings,
    73→    update: updateUISettings,
    74→    isLoading: isUISettingsLoading,
    75→  } = useToolSettings<Record<string, unknown>>(settingsToolId, {
    76→    projectId,
    77→    enabled: !!projectId,
    78→  });
    79→
    80→  // Load last edited media from database settings on mount
    81→  useEffect(() => {
    82→    if (!projectId || isUISettingsLoading || hasLoadedFromSettings.current) return;
    83→
    84→    const storedId = uiSettings?.lastEditedMediaId as string | undefined;
    85→    hasLoadedFromSettings.current = true; // Mark as attempted even if no stored ID
    86→
    87→    if (storedId && !selectedMedia) {
    88→      setIsLoadingPersistedMedia(true);
    89→      getSupabase()
    90→        .from('generations')
    91→        .select('*')
    92→        .eq('id', storedId)
    93→        .single()
    94→        .then(({ data, error }) => {
    95→          if (data && !error) {
    96→            const gen = data as GenerationRow;
    97→            preloadMedia?.(gen);
    98→            setSelectedMediaState(gen);
    99→            // Let caller restore extra state from settings
   100→            if (onSettingsLoaded && uiSettings) {
   101→              onSettingsLoaded(uiSettings);
   102→            }
   103→          } else {
   104→            // Clear invalid stored ID (use null, not undefined — deepMerge skips undefined)
   105→            updateUISettings('project', {
   106→              lastEditedMediaId: null,
   107→              ...extraClearData,
   108→            });
   109→          }
   110→          setIsLoadingPersistedMedia(false);
   111→        });
   112→    }
   113→  }, [projectId, uiSettings?.lastEditedMediaId, isUISettingsLoading, selectedMedia, updateUISettings, preloadMedia, onSettingsLoaded, uiSettings, extraClearData]);
   114→
   115→  // Persist selected media ID to database settings (or clear it when media is removed)
   116→  const selectedMediaId = selectedMedia?.id;
   117→  useEffect(() => {
   118→    if (!projectId || isUISettingsLoading || !hasLoadedFromSettings.current) return;
   119→
   120→    if (selectedMediaId && selectedMediaId !== (uiSettings?.lastEditedMediaId as string | undefined)) {
   121→      updateUISettings('project', { lastEditedMediaId: selectedMediaId });
   122→      userClosedEditor.current = false; // Reset close flag when new media selected
   123→    } else if (!selectedMediaId && uiSettings?.lastEditedMediaId && userClosedEditor.current) {
   124→      // Only clear when user explicitly closed the editor, not on initial mount
   125→      // Use null, not undefined — deepMerge skips undefined values
   126→      updateUISettings('project', {
   127→        lastEditedMediaId: null,
   128→        ...extraClearData,
   129→      });
   130→    }
   131→  }, [selectedMediaId, projectId, isUISettingsLoading, uiSettings?.lastEditedMediaId, updateUISettings, extraClearData]);
   132→
   133→  // Wrapper to set media from outside (e.g. gallery selection, upload result)
   134→  const setSelectedMedia = useCallback((media: GenerationRow | null) => {
   135→    setSelectedMediaState(media);
   136→  }, []);
   137→
   138→  // Call when user explicitly closes the editor
   139→  const handleEditorClose = useCallback(() => {
   140→    userClosedEditor.current = true;
   141→    setSelectedMediaState(null);
   142→  }, []);
   143→
   144→  const showSkeleton = isUISettingsLoading || isLoadingPersistedMedia ||
   145→    (!!uiSettings?.lastEditedMediaId && !selectedMedia && !userClosedEditor.current);
   146→
   147→  return {
   148→    selectedMedia,
   149→    setSelectedMedia,
   150→    handleEditorClose,
   151→    isLoading: isUISettingsLoading || isLoadingPersistedMedia,
   152→    showSkeleton,
   153→    uiSettings,
   154→    updateUISettings,
   155→    isUISettingsLoading,
   156→    userClosedEditor,
   157→  };
   158→}
   159→
```

```
    11→
    12→export function useSegmentLightbox({ displaySlots, pairDataByIndex, selectedParentId }: UseSegmentLightboxProps) {
    13→  const [lightboxIndex, setLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
    14→
    15→  const childSlotIndices = useMemo(() =>
    16→    displaySlots
    17→      .map((slot, idx) => slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null)
    18→      .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
    19→    [displaySlots]
    20→  );
    21→
    22→  const handleLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
    23→    if (lightboxIndex === null || childSlotIndices.length === 0) return;
    24→    const currentPos = childSlotIndices.indexOf(lightboxIndex);
    25→    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % childSlotIndices.length;
    26→    setLightboxIndex(childSlotIndices[nextPos]);
    27→  }, [lightboxIndex, childSlotIndices]);
    28→
    29→  const handleLightboxPrev = useCallback(() => {
    30→    if (lightboxIndex === null || childSlotIndices.length === 0) return;
    31→    const currentPos = childSlotIndices.indexOf(lightboxIndex);
    32→    const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + childSlotIndices.length) % childSlotIndices.length;
    33→    setLightboxIndex(childSlotIndices[prevPos]);
    34→  }, [lightboxIndex, childSlotIndices]);
    35→
    36→  const handleLightboxClose = useCallback(() => {
    37→    setLightboxIndex(null);
    38→  }, []);
    39→
    40→  // Lightbox media props (memoized)
    41→  const currentLightboxSlot = useMemo(() =>
    42→    lightboxIndex !== null ? displaySlots[lightboxIndex] : null,
    43→    [lightboxIndex, displaySlots]
    44→  );
    45→  const currentLightboxMedia = useMemo(() =>
    46→    currentLightboxSlot?.type === 'child' ? currentLightboxSlot.child : null,
    47→    [currentLightboxSlot]
    48→  );
    49→
    50→  const lightboxMedia = useMemo(() => {
    51→    if (!currentLightboxMedia) return null;
    52→    const fallbackParentId = selectedParentId && !currentLightboxMedia.parent_generation_id
    53→      ? { parent_generation_id: selectedParentId }
    54→      : {};
    55→
    56→    return {
    57→      ...currentLightboxMedia,
    58→      ...fallbackParentId,
    59→    } as GenerationRow;
    60→  }, [currentLightboxMedia, selectedParentId]);
    61→
    62→  const lightboxCurrentSegmentImages = useMemo(() => {
    63→    const pairData = currentLightboxSlot ? pairDataByIndex?.get(currentLightboxSlot.index) : undefined;
    64→    const slotChildId = currentLightboxSlot?.type === 'child' ? currentLightboxSlot.child.id : undefined;
    65→    return {
    66→      startShotGenerationId: pairData?.startImage?.id || currentLightboxSlot?.pairShotGenerationId,
    67→      activeChildGenerationId: slotChildId,
    68→      startUrl: pairData?.startImage?.url,
    69→      endUrl: pairData?.endImage?.url,
    70→      startGenerationId: pairData?.startImage?.generationId,
    71→      endGenerationId: pairData?.endImage?.generationId,
    72→      startVariantId: pairData?.startImage?.primaryVariantId,
    73→      endVariantId: pairData?.endImage?.primaryVariantId,
    74→    };
    75→  }, [currentLightboxSlot, pairDataByIndex]);
    76→
    77→  const lightboxCurrentFrameCount = useMemo(() => {
    78→    const pairData = currentLightboxSlot ? pairDataByIndex?.get(currentLightboxSlot.index) : undefined;
    79→    return pairData?.frames;
    80→  }, [currentLightboxSlot, pairDataByIndex]);
    81→
    82→  return {
    83→    lightboxIndex,
    84→    setLightboxIndex,
    85→    lightboxMedia,
    86→    lightboxCurrentSegmentImages,
    87→    lightboxCurrentFrameCount,
    88→    currentLightboxMedia,
    89→    childSlotIndices,
    90→    handleLightboxNext,
    91→    handleLightboxPrev,
    92→    handleLightboxClose,
    93→  };
    94→}
```

```
   367→  images,

   370→  dimensions,

   374→    () => buildShotEditorContextInput({

   378→      settings,
   379→      dimensions,

   381→    [core, images, controllers, settings, dimensions],

   383→
   384→  const contextValue = useShotSettingsValue(contextInput);
   385→
   386→  const handleJoinSegmentsClick = useCallback(() => {
   387→    controllers.joinWorkflow.setGenerateMode('join');
   388→    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
   389→      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
   390→        const target = sections.refs.generateVideosCardRef.current;
   391→        if (!target) {
   392→          return;
   393→        }
   394→
   395→        const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
   396→        const scrollTop = window.scrollY + rect.top - 20;
   397→        window.scrollTo({ top: scrollTop, behavior: 'smooth' });
   398→      });
   399→    });
   400→  }, [controllers.joinWorkflow, sections.refs.generateVideosCardRef]);
   401→
   402→  return buildShotEditorLayoutSections({
   403→    core,
   404→    controllers,
   405→    settings,
```

```
     6→export interface DerivedItem {
     7→  id: string;
     8→  thumbUrl: string | null;
     9→  url: string | null;
    10→  createdAt: string;
    11→  derivedCount: number;
    12→  starred?: boolean;
    13→  prompt?: string;
    14→  itemType: 'generation' | 'variant';
    15→  variantType?: string | null;

    21→  all_shot_associations?: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null; position: number | null }>;
    22→}
    23→
    24→function timelineFrameToPositionBucket(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
    25→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) {
    26→    return null;
    27→  }
    28→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
    29→}
    30→
    31→function normalizePrompt(params: unknown): string | undefined {
    32→  const record = params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    33→  if (!record) {
    34→    return undefined;
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  if (typeof record.prompt === 'string') {
    38→    return record.prompt;
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  const originalParams = record.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    42→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    43→  return typeof orchestratorDetails?.prompt === 'string' ? orchestratorDetails.prompt : undefined;
    44→}
    45→
    46→function throwDerivedItemsRepositoryError(error: unknown, fallbackMessage: string): never {
    47→  if (error instanceof Error) {
    48→    throw error;
    49→  }
    50→  if (
    51→    error
    52→    && typeof error === 'object'
    53→    && 'message' in error
    54→    && typeof (error as { message?: unknown }).message === 'string'
    55→  ) {
    56→    throw new Error((error as { message: string }).message);
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  throw new Error(fallbackMessage);
    60→}
    61→
    62→export async function fetchDerivedItemsFromRepository(
    63→  sourceGenerationId: string | null,
    64→): Promise<DerivedItem[]> {
    65→  if (!sourceGenerationId) {
    66→    return [];
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const [generationsResult, variantsResult] = await Promise.all([
    70→    supabase().from('generations')
    71→      .select(`
    72→        id,
    73→        location,
    74→        thumbnail_url,
    75→        type,
    76→        created_at,
    77→        params,
    78→        starred,
    79→        tasks,
    80→        based_on,
    81→        shot_data
    82→      `)
    83→      .eq('based_on', sourceGenerationId)
    84→      .order('starred', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
    85→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
    86→    supabase().from('generation_variants')
    87→      .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type, name, params, is_primary, viewed_at')
```

```
   319→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   320→  dataQuery = applyGenerationFilters(dataQuery, filters);
   321→
   322→
   323→  // Determine sort order
   324→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   325→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   326→
   327→  // Execute query with standard server-side pagination
   328→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery
   329→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   330→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   331→
   332→  if (error) {
   333→    throw error;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  if (!data) {
   337→    return { items: [], total: totalCount, hasMore: false };
   338→  }
   339→
   340→
   341→  const finalData = data || [];
   342→  const hasMore = (offset + limit) < totalCount;
   343→
   344→  // Badge data (derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount) is now loaded
   345→  // lazily via useVariantBadges hook to avoid blocking gallery display
   346→
   347→  // Use shared transformer instead of inline transformation logic
   348→  const items = finalData?.map((item) => {
   349→    // Transform using shared function - handles all the complex logic
   350→    return transformGeneration(item as unknown as RawGeneration, {
   351→      shotId: filters?.shotId,
   352→    });
   353→  }) || [];
   354→
   355→  return { items, total: totalCount, hasMore };
   356→}
   357→
   358→export function fetchGenerations(
   359→  projectId: string | null,
   360→  limit: number = 100,
   361→  offset: number = 0,
   362→  filters?: GenerationFilters
   363→): Promise<{
   364→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   365→  total: number;
   366→  hasMore: boolean;
   367→}> {
   368→  if (!projectId) {
   369→    return Promise.resolve({ items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false });
   370→  }
   371→  return fetchGenerationsForProject(projectId, limit, offset, filters);
   372→}
   373→
   374→
   375→export type GenerationsPaginatedResponse = {
   376→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   377→  total: number;
   378→  hasMore: boolean;
   379→};
```

```
   134→  dragSource: 'batch-exchange' | 'batch-midpoint';
   135→  signal?: AbortSignal;
   136→  logPrefix: string;
```
