   139→
   140→export async function persistTimelineFrameBatchUpdates({
   141→  shotId,
   142→  updates,
   143→  operationLabel,
   144→  timeoutOperationName,
   145→  dragSource,
   146→  signal,
   147→  logPrefix,
   148→  log,
   149→}: PersistTimelineFrameBatchUpdatesInput): Promise<void> {
   150→  await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   151→    shotId,
   152→    updates: updates.map((update) => ({
   153→      shotGenerationId: update.shotGenerationId,
   154→      timelineFrame: update.timelineFrame,
   155→      metadata: {
   156→        user_positioned: true,
   157→        drag_source: dragSource,
   158→      },
   159→    })),
   160→    operationLabel,
   161→    timeoutOperationName,
   162→    signal,
   163→    logPrefix,
   164→    log,
   165→  });
   166→}
   167→
   168→interface SyncTimelineGenerationFramesInput {
   169→  shotId: string;
   170→  targets: Array<{ generationId: string; frame: number }>;
   171→  syncShotData: (generationId: string, targetShotId: string, frame: number) => Promise<void>;
   172→  signal?: AbortSignal;
   173→  logPrefix: string;
   174→  log: TimelineLogFn;
   175→  ignoreTimeout?: boolean;
   176→}
   177→
   178→export async function syncTimelineGenerationFrames({
   179→  shotId,
   180→  targets,
   181→  syncShotData,
   182→  signal,
   183→  logPrefix,
   184→  log,
   185→  ignoreTimeout = false,
   186→}: SyncTimelineGenerationFramesInput): Promise<void> {
   187→  if (targets.length === 0) {
   188→    return;
   189→  }
   190→
   191→  try {
   192→    await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   193→      'timeline-frame-sync-shot-data',
   194→      async () => {
   195→        await Promise.all(
   196→          targets.map(({ generationId, frame }) => syncShotData(generationId, shotId, frame)),
   197→        );
   198→      },
   199→      {
   200→        timeoutMs: 10_000,
   201→        upstreamSignal: signal,
   202→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs, timeoutMs }) => {
   203→          log(`${logPrefix} shot_data sync timed out`, {
   204→            shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
   205→            syncCount: targets.length,
   206→            timeoutMs,
   207→            pendingMs,
   208→          });
   209→        },
   210→      },
   211→    );
   212→  } catch (error) {
   213→    if (ignoreTimeout && isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error)) {
   214→      log(`${logPrefix} shot_data sync timeout ignored`, {
   215→        shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
   216→        syncCount: targets.length,
   217→      });
   218→      return;
   219→    }
   220→    throw error;
   221→  }
   222→}

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);

    77→          taskType: getTaskDisplayName(task.task_type),
    78→          project: projectLookup[task.project_id] || 'Unknown Project',
    79→          status: task.status,
    80→          duration: duration ? `${duration}s` : '',
    81→          cost: costEntry ? `$${Math.abs(costEntry.amount).toFixed(3)}` : 'Free',
    82→        };
    83→      });
    84→
    85→      // Apply cost filter (client-side)
    86→      if (filters.costFilter === 'free') {
    87→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => task.cost === 'Free');
    88→      } else if (filters.costFilter === 'paid') {
    89→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => task.cost !== 'Free');
    90→      }
    91→
    92→      // Convert to CSV
    93→      const headers = ['ID', 'Date', 'Task Type', 'Project', 'Status', 'Duration', 'Cost'];
    94→      const csvContent = [
    95→        headers.join(','),
    96→        ...tasks.map(task => [
    97→          task.id,
    98→          task.date,
    99→          `"${task.taskType}"`,
   100→          `"${task.project}"`,
   101→          task.status,
   102→          task.duration,
   103→          task.cost
   104→        ].join(','))
   105→      ].join('\n');
   106→
   107→      // Download file
   108→      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
   109→      const link = document.createElement('a');
   110→      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   111→      link.setAttribute('href', url);
   112→      link.setAttribute('download', `task-log-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`);
   113→      link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
   114→      document.body.appendChild(link);
   115→      link.click();
   116→      document.body.removeChild(link);
   117→
   118→    } catch (error) {
   119→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useTaskLogDownload', showToast: false });
   120→    } finally {
   121→      setIsDownloading(false);
   122→    }
   123→  }, [filters]);
   124→
   125→  return {
   126→    isDownloading,
   127→    handleDownload,
   128→  };
   129→}
   130→

    29→export async function resolveAuthenticatedMediaUserId(): Promise<string> {
    30→  const {
    31→    data: { session },
    32→  } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
    33→  if (!session?.user?.id) {
    34→    throw new Error('User not authenticated');
    35→  }
    36→  return session.user.id;
    37→}
    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Extracts a thumbnail from a video at a specific time
    41→ */
    42→function extractThumbnailFromVideo(
    43→  videoUrl: string,
    44→  timeInSeconds: number = 0.001
    45→): Promise<Blob> {
    46→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    47→    const captureElements = createVideoFrameCaptureElements();
    48→    if (!captureElements) {
    49→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    50→      return;
    51→    }
    52→    const { video, canvas, ctx } = captureElements;
    53→
    54→    configureVideoForFrameCapture(video, 'anonymous');
    55→
    56→    // Handle video loaded
    57→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    58→      // Set canvas size to video dimensions (or max 1280px width)
    59→      const maxWidth = 1280;
    60→      const scale = Math.min(1, maxWidth / video.videoWidth);
    61→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth * scale;
    62→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight * scale;
    63→
    64→      // Seek to the desired time (or start if video is shorter)
    65→      video.currentTime = Math.min(timeInSeconds, video.duration - 0.1);
    66→    });
    67→
    68→    // Handle seeked event
    69→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    70→      try {
    71→        // Draw video frame to canvas
    72→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    73→
    74→        // Convert to blob (JPEG, 85% quality)
    75→        canvas.toBlob(
    76→          (blob) => {
    77→            video.remove();
    78→            if (blob) {
    79→              resolve(blob);
    80→            } else {
    81→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    82→            }
    83→          },
    84→          'image/jpeg',
    85→          0.85
    86→        );
    87→      } catch (error) {
    88→        video.remove();
    89→        reject(error);
    90→      }
    91→    });
    92→
    93→    // Handle errors
    94→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    95→      video.remove();
    96→      reject(new Error(`Video loading failed: ${video.error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`));
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    // Start loading
   100→    video.src = getDisplayUrl(videoUrl);
   101→  });
   102→}
   103→
   104→/**
   105→ * Uploads a thumbnail blob to Supabase storage
   106→ * Note: projectId param kept for backwards compatibility but no longer used in path
   107→ */
   108→async function uploadThumbnailToStorage(
   109→  blob: Blob,
   110→  generationId: string,
   111→  _projectId: string
   112→): Promise<string> {
   113→  const userId = await resolveAuthenticatedMediaUserId();
   114→
   115→  const fileName = `${generationId}-thumb.jpg`;
   116→  const filePath = storagePaths.thumbnail(userId, fileName);
   117→
   118→  const { error } = await supabase().storage
   119→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   120→    .upload(filePath, blob, {
   121→      contentType: 'image/jpeg',
   122→      upsert: true, // Overwrite if exists
   123→    });
   124→
   125→  if (error) {
   126→    console.error('[ThumbnailGenerator] Upload failed:', error);
   127→    throw error;
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  // Get public URL
   131→  const { data: urlData } = supabase().storage
   132→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   133→    .getPublicUrl(filePath);
   134→
   135→  return urlData.publicUrl;
   136→}

   141→async function updateGenerationThumbnail(

1→// deno-lint-ignore-file
     2→/**
     3→ * System Logger for Edge Functions
     4→ *
     5→ * Logs to both console (for immediate visibility) AND system_logs table (for persistence/querying).
     6→ * Uses a buffer pattern to batch database writes for efficiency.
     7→ *
     8→ * Usage:
     9→ *   const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'my-function-name');
    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });
    11→ *   logger.error('Something failed', { task_id, error: err.message });
    12→ *   await logger.flush(); // Call before returning response
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import type { SupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
    16→
    17→type LogLevel = 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';
    18→
    19→interface LogContext {
    20→  task_id?: string;
    21→  shot_id?: string;
    22→  user_id?: string;
    23→  [key: string]: unknown;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface BufferedLog {
    27→  timestamp: string;
    28→  source_type: string;
    29→  source_id: string;
    30→  log_level: LogLevel;
    31→  message: string;
    32→  task_id: string | null;
    33→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export class SystemLogger {
    37→  private supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
    38→  private functionName: string;
    39→  private logPrefix: string;
    40→  private logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    41→  private defaultTaskId: string | null = null;
    42→
    43→  constructor(supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient, functionName: string, defaultTaskId?: string) {
    44→    this.supabaseAdmin = supabaseAdmin;
    45→    this.functionName = functionName;
    46→    this.logPrefix = `[${functionName.toUpperCase()}]`;
    47→    this.defaultTaskId = defaultTaskId || null;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  /**
    51→   * Set a default task_id that will be used for all subsequent logs
    52→   * Useful when you learn the task_id after construction
    53→   */
    54→  setDefaultTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    55→    this.defaultTaskId = taskId;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  private consoleDebugEnabled(): boolean {
    59→    return Deno?.env?.get?.('EDGE_LOG_DEBUG') === 'true';
    60→  }
    61→
    62→  private summarizeConsoleContext(context?: LogContext): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
    63→    if (!context) {
    64→      return undefined;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    const allowedKeys = [
    68→      'task_id',
    69→      'shot_id',
    70→      'user_id',
    71→      'error',
    72→      'status',
    73→      'status_code',
    74→      'method',
    75→      'repoId',
    76→      'count',
    77→    ] as const;
    78→
    79→    const summaryEntries = allowedKeys
    80→      .filter((key) => context[key] !== undefined)
    81→      .map((key) => [key, context[key]] as const);
    82→
    83→    if (summaryEntries.length === 0) {
    84→      return undefined;
    85→    }
    86→
    87→    return Object.fromEntries(summaryEntries);
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  private writeConsole(
    91→    level: LogLevel,
    92→    message: string,
    93→    context?: LogContext,
    94→  ): void {
    95→    const summary = this.summarizeConsoleContext(context);
    96→    const prefix =
    97→      level === 'WARNING'
    98→        ? `${this.logPrefix} WARN ${message}`
    99→        : level === 'ERROR'
   100→          ? `${this.logPrefix} ERROR ${message}`
   101→          : level === 'CRITICAL'
   102→            ? `${this.logPrefix} CRITICAL ${message}`
   103→            : `${this.logPrefix} ${message}`;
   104→
   105→    if (level === 'DEBUG' || level === 'INFO') {
   106→      if (!this.consoleDebugEnabled()) {
   107→        return;
   108→      }
   109→      if (summary) {
   110→        console.log(prefix, summary);
   111→        return;
   112→      }
   113→      console.log(prefix);
   114→      return;
   115→    }
   116→
   117→    if (level === 'WARNING') {
   118→      if (summary) {
   119→        console.warn(prefix, summary);
   120→        return;
   121→      }
   122→      console.warn(prefix);
   123→      return;
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    if (summary) {
   127→      console.error(prefix, summary);
   128→      return;
   129→    }
   130→    console.error(prefix);
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   134→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
   135→    
   136→    this.logBuffer.push({
   137→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   138→      source_type: 'edge_function',
   139→      source_id: this.functionName,
   140→      log_level: level,
   141→      message,
   142→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
   143→      metadata
   144→    });
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   148→    this.writeConsole('DEBUG', message, context);
   149→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   153→    this.writeConsole('INFO', message, context);
   154→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   158→    this.writeConsole('WARNING', message, context);
   159→    this.addToBuffer('WARNING', message, context);
   160→  }
   161→
   162→  error(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   163→    this.writeConsole('ERROR', message, context);
   164→    this.addToBuffer('ERROR', message, context);
   165→  }
   166→
   167→  critical(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
   168→    this.writeConsole('CRITICAL', message, context);
   169→    this.addToBuffer('CRITICAL', message, context);
   170→  }
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Flush all buffered logs to the database
   174→   * Call this before returning your response!
   175→   */
   176→  async flush(): Promise<{ inserted: number; errors: number }> {
   177→    if (this.logBuffer.length === 0) {
   178→      return { inserted: 0, errors: 0 };
   179→    }
   180→
   181→    try {
   182→      const { data, error } = await this.supabaseAdmin
   183→        .rpc('func_insert_logs_batch', { logs: this.logBuffer });
   184→
   185→      if (error) {
   186→        console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Failed to flush ${this.logBuffer.length} logs to database:`, error.message);
   187→        // Don't clear buffer on error - logs are lost but at least console has them
   188→        return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   189→      }
   190→
   191→      const result = data || { inserted: this.logBuffer.length, errors: 0 };
   192→      const bufferSize = this.logBuffer.length;
   193→      this.logBuffer = []; // Clear buffer after successful flush
   194→      return { inserted: result.inserted || bufferSize, errors: result.errors || 0 };
   195→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   196→      console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Exception flushing logs:`, e?.message || e);
   197→      return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   198→    }
   199→  }
   200→
   201→  /**
   202→   * Get the current buffer size (useful for debugging)
   203→   */
   204→  getBufferSize(): number {
   205→    return this.logBuffer.length;
   206→  }
   207→}
   208→

greedy match of the line spec\n    result = re.sub(\n        r'((?:src|supabase)/[^\\s:,\\'\")\\]`]+):(\\d+(?:-\\d+)?(?:,\\s*(?:and\\s+)?\\d+(?:-\\d+)?)*)',\n        replace_line_ref,\n        result\n    )\n    \n    # Pattern 2: double-colon method refs like file.ts::method\n    result = re.sub(\n        r'((?:src|supabase)/[^\\s:,\\'\")\\]`]+)::(\\w+)',\n        r'\\1 (function \\2)',\n        result\n    )\n    \n    return result\n\n# Verify fixes work\nfor (cname, step_num), detail in sorted(fixes.items()):\n    fixed = fix_detail(detail)\n    # Check if all paths are now valid\n    remaining_paths = re.findall(r'(?:src/|supabase/)[^\\s,\\'\")\\]`]+', fixed)\n    still_bad = []\n    for p in remaining_paths:\n        p = p.rstrip('.,;:)')\n        if not os.path.exists(p):\n            still_bad.append(p)\n    if still_bad:\n        print(f'STILL BAD: {cname} step {step_num}:')\n        for p in still_bad:\n            print(f'  {p}')\n        print(f'  Fixed detail preview: {fixed[:300]}')\n        print()\n\nprint(f'\\nTotal steps to fix: {len(fixes)}')\nPYEOF\n",
